items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Salary: PHP 80,000 to PHP 120,000/monthly Working Hours & Conditions: Sydney, AU Business Hours and Holidays Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is an integrated property and place marketing agency combining brand strategy, high-end creative, and performance-driven lead generation. Our client portfolio primarily consists of leading Australian property developers marketing off-the-plan residential communities, completed luxury stock, and premium commercial assets. We believe true marketing effectiveness requires total alignment across creative narrative, digital targeting, technical attribution, and sales enablement. ROLE OVERVIEW: We are seeking an autonomous, hands-on Senior Performance Marketing Manager to take full operational ownership of paid advertising across our client roster. In this role, you will steer paid media strategy and day-to-day execution across Meta Ads and Google Search, scaling an account base expected to expand to approximately seven multi-channel client accounts in early 2027. Operating alongside our senior strategy, video, and design directors, you will look beyond basic surface metrics to optimize the entire acquisition funnel. Your core mandate is turning paid traffic into qualified buyer enquiries, booked display suite appointments, and closed developer sales. RESPONSIBILITIES: Paid Media Execution & Management: Architect, launch, and optimize high-converting Meta Ads and Google Search campaigns. Manage budget pacing, audience segmentation, bid strategies, search queries, and negative keyword lists. Maintain meticulous account hygiene, access controls, billing protocols, naming conventions, and policy compliance. Creative Strategy & Iterative Testing: Translate high-level project personas, narrative angles, and visual hooks into rigorous creative testing frameworks. Set minimum spend thresholds, monitor fatigue indicators, and deliver structured briefs to internal design and video teams for iterations, variations, and net-new creative concepts. Tracking, Attribution & Offline Data: Set up, audit, and troubleshoot tracking architecture via GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Pixel, and Conversions API (CAPI). Integrate CRM data pipelines to enable closed-loop offline conversion tracking. Data Visualization & Client Reporting: Build and manage Looker Studio dashboards demonstrating true acquisition ROI, downstream appointment volume, and sales conversion rates. Deliver structured weekly written updates detailing performance drivers, strategic shifts, and upcoming optimizations. Conversion Rate Optimization & Funnel Operations: Audit full user journeys from click to qualification, proposing ongoing landing page enhancements. Execute technical SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) initiatives in coordination with senior leadership, including site speed fixes and email nurture workflows. AI Workflow Integration: Leverage AI tools across daily operations, data analysis, reporting synthesis, and rapid creative ideation. Develop and document standard operating procedures that leverage AI to increase throughput without compromising quality or strategic rigor. Agency & Account Scale: Minimum of 5 years of direct, hands-on performance marketing experience, with a proven track record managing multi-client portfolios within an agency setting. Channel Mastery: Deep, current technical proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search). Downstream Conversion Focus: Demonstrated history driving high-intent B2C or high-consideration lead generation, measuring success by sales outcomes rather than raw lead volume. Technical Infrastructure: Hands-on experience configuring GA4, GTM, Meta CAPI, offline conversion feeds, and custom Looker Studio dashboards. Attribution Acumen: Solid understanding of multi-touch attribution, channel mix modeling constraints, and cross-platform reporting discrepancies. AI Fluency: Active, daily integration of AI workflows into campaign development, copy iteration, or analytical operations. Communication & Cadence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce executive-ready client summaries and precise creative briefs. Operational Alignment: Full availability to work aligned with Sydney, Australia (AEST/AEDT) business hours. Preferred Conversion Optimization: Practical expertise in landing page design principles, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and site speed auditing. Modern Search: Exposure to technical SEO execution and AI search optimization (AEO/GEO). Vertical Experience: Prior exposure to Australian real estate, specifically residential off-the-plan project marketing. Lifecycle Marketing: Hands-on automation experience configuring email qualification funnels in platforms such as Zoho or Brevo. What You’ll Bring Full-Funnel Ownership: A commercial mindset that views media spend as an investment engine tied directly to pipeline appointments and revenue. Analytical Independence: The confidence to diagnose sudden performance shifts, troubleshoot faulty tracking scripts, and proactively bring solutions rather than problems. Creative Curiosity: The ability to decipher why specific visual hooks work, bridging data analysis with sharp creative direction. Process Rigor: Strong personal project management, high attention to operational detail, and the discipline to maintain structured experiments across dynamic accounts. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-senior-performance-marketing-manager-dayshift-remote

items.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity 🚀 Carrot is seeking a Sr. Data Engineer to lead the evolution, reliability, and scalability of our modern data infrastructure across analytics, reporting, and business intelligence. In this role, you will architect, build, and maintain robust, automated data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, integrate diverse data sources, and partner with stakeholders across the business to deliver secure, compliant, high-quality data solutions. Your work will span the full data lifecycle, from architecting resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and developing real-time and batch data integrations to automating reporting, reducing technical debt, and enabling advanced analytics. Sr. Data Engineers at Carrot are operational stewards and technical mentors, driving improvements in system maturity, cost efficiency, automation, and collaborative practices. You will join our Data Engineering team, which develops and optimizes scalable data pipelines and cloud infrastructure to enable secure, automated reporting and analytics across Carrot. The team collaborates closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Finance, Legal, and Commercial partners to deliver reliable integrations and self-serve solutions that drive business insights and operational efficiency. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Architect, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, dbt, and orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow Administer and optimize cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud, integrating new sources and tuning for performance and cost Orchestrate data workflows with custom scheduling, alerting, dependency management, monitoring, and error resolution Design and maintain secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance Automate manual reporting and operational tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components that reduce operational overhead Partner with backend product engineers to optimize production database schemas with analytics use cases in mind Strengthen data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation practices across key data domains Mentor teammates and reinforce best practices in version control, code review, and structured workflow management What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Taken end-to-end ownership of core pipelines and integrations, with measurable improvements in reliability, data recency, and cost efficiency Automated high-effort manual workflows, reducing operational risk and freeing capacity for higher-value engineering work Delivered secure, compliant data integrations that stakeholders across the business trust for decision-making Strengthened observability across the platform, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response for critical data workflows Established yourself as a technical mentor and a go-to partner for Business Intelligence, Product, and cross-functional teams About You ✨ You likely have: Expert-level proficiency in Snowflake, dbt, and Python for data modeling, transformation, pipeline development, and advanced analytics Advanced SQL skills for complex querying, large-scale data model design, and database optimization Proven experience architecting, building, testing, deploying, and maintaining scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow Hands-on administration of cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud A strong understanding of secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance Mastery of version control (Git, GitHub) and structured workflow management (Jira) for code review, audit trails, and operational transparency A demonstrated ability to automate and simplify complex manual tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components Dependability, adaptability, and a collaborative approach to engineering, thriving in dynamic and ambiguous environments Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Hands-on experience in startup or rapid-growth environments, delivering technical solutions under shifting priorities A background supporting business intelligence, analytics, and data science teams through large-scale integrations and multi-tenant reporting Familiarity with both batch and event-driven ingestion paradigms, including near-real-time pipelines built on Snowflake, dbt, and Python Experience automating operational, financial, or compliance-driven workflows within cloud data environments Exposure to audit, privacy, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO, and SOX, particularly in data governance and secure access controls Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, healthtech, or SaaS Why This Role Matters 🧡 Reliable data is the foundation of how Carrot operates, from the analytics that guide business decisions to the reporting our customers and partners depend on. The systems this role owns determine the accuracy, recency, and security of data used across the entire company. As Carrot scales globally, the Sr. Data Engineer will make our data platform more automated, resilient, and cost-efficient, enabling teams across the business to move faster with data they trust. This work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Interview Process 🤝 We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation: Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $145,000-$165,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

items.title: Data Scientist
items.summary: Job Summary:We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team.
items.description: Job Summary: We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing machine learning models, and deriving actionable insights to drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in statistics, machine learning, and programming, along with the ability to work independently in a remote environment. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your skills to real-world problems and contribute to innovative projects from anywhere in the world. Responsibilities: Analyze large datasets to extract meaningful patterns, trends, and insights using statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms. Develop predictive models and algorithms to solve business problems and optimize decision-making processes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project objectives, gather requirements, and prioritize tasks. Clean, preprocess, and manipulate data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency for analysis. Build and deploy machine learning models into production environments, and monitor their performance over time. Interpret and communicate analysis results and insights to stakeholders through visualizations, reports, and presentations. Stay updated with the latest developments in data science, machine learning, and AI technologies, and apply them to improve existing models and methodologies. Conduct experiments and A/B tests to evaluate model performance and validate hypotheses. Mentor junior data scientists and provide guidance on best practices in data analysis and modeling. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; Master's or Ph.D. degree is a plus. Minimum of 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or related fields. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, along with experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). Strong understanding of statistical concepts and methods, and experience with hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and time series forecasting. Hands-on experience with machine learning techniques such as classification, regression, clustering, and natural language processing. Familiarity with data visualization tools and techniques (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau). Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently and as part of a remote team. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. #DataScientist #RemoteWork #MachineLearning #DataAnalysis #DataScience #RemoteJob #AI #PredictiveModeling #DataMining #Statistics #RemoteTech #WorkFromAnywhere #TechJobs #DataAnalytics #ArtificialIntelligence #Python #RemoteOpportunity Originally posted on Himalayas

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect wit
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - USA Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join: People Analytics & Research is a strong team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analysts. Our work is highly sought-after, and impacts stakeholders in our People function, and across the business. In this role, you'll take on some of the hardest questions about Airbnb's workforce - how we recruit, pay, develop, and retain our people - partnering with leaders across Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, and the wider business to turn rigorous analysis into decisions they act on. The Difference You Will Make: The People Analytics & Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity & Belonging. We need a Data Scientist with a proven track record of translating data into insight and action. If you have a proven background in this field and are excited to help build Airbnb’s community, we want to hear from you. A Typical Day: Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards Lead design and measurement of Airbnb's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb Use AI fluently - including the team's AirPanda platform and LLM-based agents - to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and to extend what a single researcher can deliver Your Expertise: 5+ years in industry experience and a Master's degree/PhD in a quantitative field Deep experience with causal inference on observational data and quasi-experimental research design and analysis Proficiency in R or Python for statistical analysis, and SQL for data access Familiarity with survey design and analysis, as one of several methods in the toolkit Experience applying data science to compensation, recruiting, or broader workforce and organizational questions, including work with legally sensitive data Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels and drive impact Experience working with large practical datasets Your Location: This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list . If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. Equal Employment Opportunity : Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. How We'll Take Care of You: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. Pay Range $180,000 — $210,000 USD Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airbnb-senior-data-scientist-people-analytics-research

items.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer. Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI. Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes). Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis. Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel. Requirements Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company. Strong SQL and Python , with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics. Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics. Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders , and pushing back on ill-defined asks. Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour. Bonus Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product. Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers. Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access. Growth potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales. Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI). Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote, US (Remote) About Mixpanel Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Customer Engineering Team Mixpanel's Customer Engineering teams are analytics consultants who embed themselves within our enterprise customer teams to drive business outcomes. We work with prospects and customers throughout the customer journey to understand what drives value, and serve as the technical counterpart to our Sales organisation to deliver on that value. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Customer Value Architects, Product, Engineering, and Support to successfully roll out self-serve analytics within our customers' organisations, help manage change, execute on technical projects and services that delight our customers, and ultimately drive ROI on the customer's Mixpanel investment. About the Role Our Customer Engineers are inquisitive, nimble, and able to clearly articulate the technical benefits and requirements of Mixpanel to developers and product managers, while also communicating the business value of our product to senior executives. In your first month, you'll become a Mixpanel expert—both in features and functionality as well as implementation. You'll shadow customer calls and demos with current Customer Engineers and Account Executives while learning to articulate our value proposition, and be trained on Mixpanel's internal systems and tools. Within your first three months, you'll be directly involved in deal cycles with Account Executives. You'll lead the technical qualification for customer use cases and deliver customised demos for prospects and existing customers, working directly with leadership at the prospect's organisation to understand business challenges that can be solved through an analytics platform. You'll also work with the prospect's business and technical teams to scope and execute proof-of-concept projects to establish Mixpanel's value—including consulting on data ingestion methods, overall architecture, success criteria, and rollout strategies for analytics tools across an organisation. Responsibilities Serve as a trusted technical advisor for prospects, providing strategic consultation on data architecture, governance, instrumentation, and business outcomes Communicate and consult effectively at all levels of the customer's organisation to earn trust and influence buying decisions Bridge the technical-business gap—working with senior stakeholders to define success for proofs-of-concept and ensuring successful execution and outcomes Leverage your Mixpanel expertise and technical/consultative skills to impart best practices throughout proof-of-concept projects Partner with Account Executives to drive revenue growth, serving as the key technical contact for customers Partner with post-sales teams to ensure that pre-sales value propositions translate into tangible post-sales results Develop relationships and uncover the needs of key technical stakeholders within your assigned book of business Be the "Voice of the Prospect" by collecting feedback from potential Mixpanel customers and sharing it with the Product team We're Looking For Someone Who Has Fluency in business and conversational Spanish and English. The ability to communicate with stakeholders at all levels—from discussing APIs with developers to organisational efficiency with CIOs. A demonstrated track record of qualifying and selling technical solutions to executive stakeholders 6+ years of experience in a Software-as-a-Service Sales Engineering or related role Experience in data querying, modelling, and transformation using tools such as SQL, dbt, Python, Business Intelligence platforms, or Product Analytics tools Familiarity with databases and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google Cloud, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks) A successful record of experience in sales engineering, consulting, or technical project management Excellent written, analytical, communication, and presentation skills Strong process and project delivery discipline Proficiency with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Gemini The ability to travel as needed Bonus Points For Experience with value engineering frameworks: translating customer pain into quantified business outcomes, building ROI calculators, and leading executive-level value conversations tied to measurable KPIs Exposure to product-led growth (PLG) environments and sales-assisted conversion motions Background in high-growth SaaS environments (Series B–E or beyond) #LI-Remote Compensation The amount listed below is the total target cash compensation (TTCC) and includes base compensation and variable compensation in the form of either a company bonus or commissions. Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. You can view our benefits offerings here . Our salary ranges are determined by role and level and are benchmarked to data released by Radford, a global compensation database. The range displayed represents the minimum and maximum TTCC. To stay on top of market conditions, we refresh our salary ranges twice a year so these ranges may change in the future. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. If you have questions about the specific range, your recruiter can share this information. items.description: ABOUT OLIPOP At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you. This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity. Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone. The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave. In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together. So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time. ABOUT THE ROLE: OLIPOP is looking for a commercially minded, analytical, and process-driven Trade & Promotion Optimization Manager to help us get the most out of every trade and promotional dollar. This role owns two of our four levers of Revenue Growth Management (RGM): trade optimization and promotion optimization. The Trade & Promotion Optimization Manager will lead the optimization of trade spend and promotional strategies with our Sales team, ensuring we invest in the right places, at the right times, and in the right ways as OLIPOP continues to grow. The role owns our Trade Promotion Management (TPM) system, including data accuracy, system maintenance, and trade visibility across the business. This person will work closely with Sales and Finance and coordinate with our Pricing & Portfolio Strategy Manager. Over time, the role will build OLIPOP’s trade promotion optimization (TPO) capability, including predictive promo modeling, scenario planning, and automated dashboards. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Trade Promotion Management & Governance Own Confido, our TPM platform, as the system of record for trade planning and promotional investment Own, maintain, and automate data workflows across Confido, Anaplan, and syndicated sources, including hands-on management of Alteryx workflows Train Sales and cross-functional users, set data-entry standards, and drive consistent use of the system Own trade rate performance through checkbook management, reviewing promo plans against trade guardrails and flagging exceptions in the approval workflow Partner with Finance to ensure promo plans, spend, trade rates, accruals, and actuals are accurate and reconciled across Confido, Anaplan, and financial reporting Promotion Optimization Lead pre- and post-event analysis, including lift, ROI, and incrementality, using TPM and syndicated data Design optimal promotional strategies by account, including depth, frequency, mechanic, and timing Lead the annual promotional calendar and promo guardrails, aligned with the Director of RGM Turn findings into clear recommendations and ensure they are implemented in customer trade plans Trade Optimization Analyze trade spend by account, channel, and pack to show where investment pays back, and identify savings such as out-of-guardrail spend, duplicate accruals, and low-return fees Support annual operating plan (AOP) trade targets and plan vs. actual tracking Provide the Director of RGM with clear recommendations on trade investment trade-offs QUALIFICATIONS: 8+ years of relevant experience in Trade Promotion Management, Revenue Growth Management, Commercial Planning, or related CPG roles Hands-on experience with a TPM platform (Confido, Anaplan, SAP TPM, Blacksmith, etc.), including user training and adoption Strong understanding of trade accruals, trade rates, and promo governance Proven experience with pre- and post-event analysis and promotional ROI, including lift and incrementality Advanced Excel required; Alteryx experience highly preferred; Tableau or Power BI a plus Experience with syndicated data (Circana, Nielsen, SPINS, Numerator) preferred Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on data accuracy Strong communicator who can train users and influence cross-functional partners REPORTS TO: Director, Revenue Growth Management COMPENSATION: $105,000 - $120,000 + Bonus HOW WE WORK We may be fully remote, but we’re anything but disconnected. OLIPOP has grown from a few passionate people around a table to a nationwide team, and we’ve done it without losing our collaborative spirit or sense of purpose. Connection here is intentional. From cross-functional projects and IRL offsites to thoughtful Slack threads and spontaneous gifs, we make the effort to stay close, even across time zones. Sure, we move quickly, but we lead with trust, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing work that matters. We value thoughtful debate. We give feedback with care and receive it with curiosity, knowing that real growth, both personal and collective, comes from listening as much as leading. Because at OLIPOP, it’s not just about getting things done. It’s about growing together, staying true to what matters, and building something with lasting impact. WHAT WE VALUE At OLIPOP, our values aren’t just posters on a wall. They shape how we show up: for each other, for our customers, and for the mission we’re chasing together. Mission Connectivity : Everything we do ladders up to our shared goal: supporting human health. Whether launching a new flavor or conducting clinical research, the mission stays front and center. Indomitable Spirit : When things get messy, we get inventive. We stay curious, adapt quickly, and find the path forward, most likely with a dedicated Slack thread and a beautifully overbuilt deck. Lead at Every Level : Leadership isn’t about titles, it’s about ownership. We speak up, follow through, and lift each other up. If you’ve got ideas and initiative, you’ve got influence. Courageous Humility: We’re confident in what we bring and curious about what we don’t know (yet). We give feedback with care, take it with grace, and know that real growth takes both. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Success at OLIPOP doesn’t come from checking boxes; it comes from living our values, staying curious, and finding energy in both the pace and the purpose. We’re building something big, and we’re looking for people who: Think big, move fast, and take thoughtful risks Thrive in a high-performance, feedback-rich environment Value real human connection and honest collaboration Are fired up by building something new, and making it better every day Startup life at OLIPOP is equally fun and fast-paced. If you’re energized by a dynamic environment, eager to grow, and excited to help shape something meaningful from the inside out, OLIPOP is a one-of-a-kind ride. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or other needs during the application process and employment. To request an accommodation, please contact The People Team at recruiting@drinkolipop.com. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. OLIPOP will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, gender (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law. Submission of Application Materials Applicants are required to submit only the materials specifically requested as part of the application process. Please do not include any unsolicited materials, as they will not be reviewed or considered. Unsolicited materials may include, but are not limited to: Marketing or promotional concepts Business ideas or strategies Photographs, videos, or other media Presentations, designs, or other creative content By submitting any materials beyond those explicitly requested, you agree that: You are voluntarily providing such materials; You irrevocably assign all rights, title, and interest in and to those materials to Olipop Inc.; and Olipop Inc. may use, reproduce, modify, distribute, or otherwise exploit such materials for any purpose anywhere in the world, without restriction or compensation.

items.description: About CookUnity : Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Role As a Senior Product Data Analyst , you will be an analytical partner to Product, Design, Engineering, and User Research. You will help teams understand both sides of CookUnity's marketplace: how customers find meals that fit their lives and how chef supply, variety, and merchandising shape that experience. You will own measurement and analysis for a product area, turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, and use evidence to guide product decisions. Our teams operate through clear success metrics, rapid learning, and controlled experiments. You will help them distinguish meaningful customer and business outcomes from activity, evaluate tradeoffs across the funnel and customer lifecycle, and make insights accessible in day-to-day decisions. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy and close cross-functional partnership. What You'll Do in 12 Months Make the marketplace easier to discover and more relevant: Study how customers browse chefs, meals, cuisines, dietary options, and price points. Analyze the relationship between local assortment, variety, personalization, and ordering behavior. Help Product identify where better discovery or merchandising can improve repeat ordering and retention. Improve the journey from first visit to lasting habit: Map the customer funnel from acquisition through first order, early repeat orders, and longer-term retention. Find friction in onboarding, menu exploration, checkout, and weekly ordering. Segment customers thoughtfully so teams can improve conversion and retention without hiding weak experiences behind averages. Measure product bets with credible experiments: Partner with Product and Engineering to define hypotheses, primary metrics, guardrails, sample sizes, and holdouts for changes to the funnel, personalization, loyalty, and in-product interventions. Analyze heterogeneous effects and uncertainty, and recommend whether to launch, iterate, or stop. When a randomized test is impractical, use the strongest available observational approach and explain its limits. Connect customer value to marketplace economics: Help teams evaluate how product changes affect order rate, churn, revenue per customer, discounts, chef engagement, and unit economics together. For new categories and ordering formats, define the measures that show whether customers find value and whether the model can scale. Reduce the work and stress of ordering: Combine behavioral data with research and customer feedback to understand where subscriptions, delivery information, account management, or support journeys create friction. Measure whether self-service and product improvements solve the underlying problem, not just move contacts to another channel. Build a trusted measurement foundation: Define and document product metrics, cohorts, event tracking, and dashboards. Work with Engineering and Data partners to validate instrumentation and maintain reliable behavioral data. Create compelling dashboards that let product teams explore results, spot meaningful patterns, and monitor outcomes after launch. Shape a focused learning agenda: Work with Product, Design, and User Research to prioritize the most consequential unknowns, design analyses and tests, and tell a clear story about what the team learned. Share methods and review work with other analysts to raise the quality of product analytics across the team. What Success Looks Like Product teams use clear metrics and guardrails to make decisions about discovery, conversion, ordering, and retention. Major launches are supported by credible tests or well-explained evidence, including their impact on different customer segments. Insights lead to measurable improvements in customer experience and repeat ordering while accounting for marketplace and financial tradeoffs. Stakeholders trust and regularly use self-service reporting, and core behavioral data is sufficiently complete to diagnose product performance. Core Competences/Requirements Approximately 5–7 years in product analytics or a closely related analytical role, with demonstrated ownership of complex analyses and influence on product decisions. Equivalent experience and evidence of impact are welcome. Practical fluency with AI tools for accelerating analysis, coding, research synthesis, documentation, and repeatable workflows; able to verify outputs and handle company and customer data responsibly. Strong SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large, complex behavioral datasets; ability to validate data and write clear, reusable analyses. Practical command of product metrics, funnel and cohort analysis, segmentation, and marketplace or subscription dynamics. Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, including holdouts, guardrails, uncertainty, and tradeoffs; sound judgment about causal claims. Ability to turn an ambiguous product problem into a focused learning plan, work independently, and communicate an actionable recommendation. Clear data storytelling and constructive partnership with Product, Design, Engineering, User Research, and business teams. Ability to build powerful, intuitive dashboards in any tool that answer important product questions, reveal actionable insights, and enable trustworthy self-service analysis. Ability to evaluate AI-enabled product experiences through clear success metrics, experiments, user feedback, and appropriate quality and safety checks. Curiosity about food, chefs, customer behavior, and the practical constraints of operating a local marketplace. Benefits 💸 Get paid in USD. 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want. ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date. 🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays. 🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider. 🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical. 🐣 Paid family leave. 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises. 🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more. 🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster. 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach. If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time! CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability. A quick note for all candidates We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us: Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page . We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away. If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Utah URL: https://www.chirocat.com/ About Us and Why We're Hiring We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients. The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in! We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us. That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us. What We're Looking For REQUIREMENTS For this role, you must: Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan) Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow) Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving! Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS These aren't required, but will help you stand out: Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell. Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom) Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google) Comfort making short-form video Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.) Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume. Life at ChiroCat ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do. HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify. Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone. Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler channel! Great Benefits: We offer fantastic health, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of the premium covered for you and affordable rates for dependents. This is a salaried role with a starting salary of $95k–$130k a year. Most new hires start in the lower to middle part of that range, and the top end is reserved for the rare candidates with truly exceptional, deep, and directly relevant experience. You’ll Make a Real Impact: This role will have an incredible impact on the lives of our doctors and staff, not to mention the patients they serve. You’ll be instrumental in helping chiropractors find and trust ChiroCat as their EHR of choice. ChiroCat is the core of their business and their ability to serve patients, so their success with ChiroCat has far-reaching implications. Additionally, we're growing, and the road ahead is exciting. You'd be joining at a stage where you can meaningfully shape our brand and voice, perception in the market, and our trajectory. That kind of impact doesn't come along often. And do it with Great People: We're firm believers that the foundation of success is building a great team. You’ll be joining a team full of truly exceptional people. The kind you’ll be excited to work with and learn to care about. People who get stuff done. Who are genuine to their core. Who hold humility and confidence equally well at the same time. Who support each other and care deeply about our customers. It’s a strong culture that’s apparent the moment you walk through the [digital] door. And we can’t wait to see how you’ll make us even better. If this sounds like your ideal environment, read on because now we’ll dig into the role itself. What You'll Do at ChiroCat At ChiroCat, marketing isn’t about being the loudest voice in the room. It’s about being the most trustworthy one. Chiropractors get plenty of noise from software vendors: big promises, long contracts, and slick ads for products that feel twenty years old. We want people to meet the real ChiroCat, the same one our customers already know. Everything we put into the world should sound like us, look like us, and be true. Your early focus will be brand: making sure that whatever someone sees of ChiroCat, whether it’s our website, our ads, our social posts, our reviews, or the messages inside our app, gives them an accurate (and awesome) picture of who we are. Next up is widening the funnel and building our inbound lead flow. Down the road, perhaps you’ll build a marketing team, one amazing hire at a time, but let’s not get ahead of ourselves. This role reports to the CEO and works closely with our Head of Customer Success, our CTO, and our Sales team. A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT INCLUDE: Rewriting a page of our website so it sounds like us, and not like every other EHR vendor Taking over our Facebook ads from our CEO (Psst… he’s relieved, and honestly, so are the ads and the people viewing them!) Jumping into a Facebook group thread where chiropractors are comparing software, and being genuinely curious and helpful instead of defensive or salesy. Planning next week’s social posts, and making sure at least one of them shows off the people behind ChiroCat (our team is way more fun than our current feed suggests); next week you’ll execute that plan. Working with our Customer Success team to rewrite in-app messages so new customers feel like they’re hearing from ChiroCat, not a robot Responding to a G2 review thoughtfully and honestly Sitting in on a sales call or reading through support chats to hear how chiropractors actually describe their problems Briefing a designer on next week’s ad creative, or making it yourself Drafting an email campaign that people actually want to open Bringing a proposal to the CEO: “Here’s what I think we should work on first, and why.” Learning the difference between a 98940 and a 98941 (you’ll get there, we promise) You’re the right fit if: You think in brand, not just funnel. Leads matter, and you know how to get them (we’ll need lots of them). But you also know that the way people feel about us impacts our success from beginning to end. Words matter to you. You obsess over the right word and notice when a sentence is trying too hard. You can write in a voice that isn’t your own, yet somehow make it sound effortless. You don’t wait for the next task. You look around, spot what’s missing, and come up with a plan. You’re the driver, not a passenger. You have taste. You can tell when something looks off, sounds generic, or feels like it came out of a template (or AI), and you won’t ship it. You’re humbly confident. You’ll make a strong case for your ideas, and you’ll change your mind when someone shows you something better. You love being a jack of all trades. Writing copy in the morning, digging into ad performance after lunch, and tweaking a landing page before you log off sounds like a great day to you. You measure what matters. You care about results more than activity, and you’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t. You’re obsessive about getting a good ROI on our ad spend and efforts. You love learning complex things. Chiropractic workflows? Insurance billing? How a front desk really runs? You’ll dive in. Because you can’t market what you don’t understand. You’d rather build than maintain. A website that needs a rethink and a brand that’s still taking shape sounds like an opportunity to you, not a mess. You see feedback as a gift. Even when it’s offered imperfectly but kindly, you stay curious instead of defensive, and look for the nugget that helps you grow. Ready to Apply? Apply (here: https://apply.workable.com/chirocat/j/5198B94A48?utm_source=wwr ) by 11:59 PM on Monday, November 30th, 2026. TWO IMPORTANT NOTES: We don’t want to see AI answers (yes, we can tell). We use AI at ChiroCat all the time, but we’re hiring you, not an AI agent. We want YOUR answers. We review applications as they come in, so we might find our perfect fit early! We don’t recommend waiting until the last minute. WHAT TO INCLUDE (IN PDF FORMAT, PLEASE): Your resume A cover letter (Yep, we read them!) Page 1: Skip the formal stuff and help us get to know you. Pretend we just met at a picnic. Introduce yourself, explain why you’re interested, and why you think you’d be great in this role. Include the word "rambunctious" somewhere (we want to make sure you're real and read this whole thing). Page 2: Answer this in 1-2 paragraphs: “Pretend you’re hiring for this role. What is the most important trait or skill you’re looking for in an applicant? Why?” PS: Not interested, but know someone who might be? Please pass it along! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/chirocat-humbly-confident-marketing-lead

items.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Sales Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with the sales team and other teams across Stripe to drive highly strategic initiatives. This team is integral in the success of our sales organization. With a commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the art and science of sales, our team is dedicated to informing the sales strategy, optimising processes, and providing insights that propel our sales growth. We do this by being objective, trusted partners to the Sales Leadership team. What you’ll do We are seeking a technically sophisticated and detail oriented individual who will serve as a Sales Strategy and Operations Data Analyst in support of the AMER Velocity (Commercial and SMB) business. This person will be responsible for improving the quality of sales analytics and insights, including standardization of reporting and scalability with the primary objective of enabling sales leadership to make effective, analytically driven decisions. You will work primarily with Sales Leadership and other cross-functional business partners to drive the operational cadence and strategy/planning of the business. Responsibilities Operating Cadence: Execute on a standard weekly, monthly and quarterly cadence of operations (weekly forecasting calls, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews). Business Insights: Develop a deep understanding of the Velocity business and its sales funnel. Provide actionable insights and a strategic perspective on business performance to help inform key decisions. Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to business leads and influence strategic decision-making. Strategy / Planning: Analyze sales and revenue data and other metrics to build models and provide actionable recommendations to shape the strategy during the annual planning process (resource planning, territory design, target/quota setting and management). Program and Process Management: Independently develop and manage project or program plans to support requests from key stakeholder and core operational planning processes. Manage segment wide operational processes and programs including but not limited to sales territory development. Scalable Insight: Conceptualize, build, manage and maintain centralized tools (including spreadsheet models, dashboards) that the business and Sales Strategy & Operations team can use to extract data / insights for daily business management in an automated manner to drive current and future rhythms of business. As a result of insights, identify and improve the usability and accessibility of insights from existing systems and tools, in collaboration with respective development teams. Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 3–5 years of work experience in B2B sales strategy and operations and/or business analytics, business strategy/operations, data science, investment banking, management consulting, and/or related domains. Strong analytical skills, business intuition and a structured approach to solving complex business problems. User-first mindset: Ability to work proactively and collaboratively with stakeholders, particularly in clearly communicating data insights and takeaways. Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality. Pragmatic problem solver, with a bias to action and “getting things done”. Passionate about driving business outcomes and change at the ground level. Ability to communicate technical content to non-technical audiences and translate business insights into practical recommendations, with a willingness to grow into presenting to leadership. Experience initiating and completing analytical projects, taking a structured approach to solving unique business problems. Experience in Salesforce (or other CRM). Intermediate to advanced SQL and strong Google Sheets or Excel modeling skills. Experience working with large data sets, especially in analyzing large imperfect data sets to creatively solve problems and creating scalable reports and dashboards or ad-hoc analysis in a fast-paced, high-volume business. Preferred qualifications Proficiency in BI visualization tools (e.g., Tableau). Interest in learning and applying AI tools to improve analytical and operational workflows.
