items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - India Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. Location Note We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. The Opportunity We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join Oportun’s Model Risk Management team and help provide independent oversight of models used across the business. You’ll evaluate model design, methodology, assumptions, implementation, performance, and ongoing monitoring to help ensure models are appropriate, well-controlled, and aligned with Oportun’s risk-management standards. This is a senior individual contributor role that combines quantitative analysis, independent model validation, governance, and cross-functional influence. You’ll work closely with model developers, Risk, Data Science, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to challenge model approaches, identify material risks, and strengthen model risk practices across Oportun. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll independently review and validate statistical, machine learning, and decisioning models used across Oportun, including models supporting consumer credit loss forecasting, liquidity and funding, and capital markets activities. You’ll assess model methodology, assumptions, data quality, feature selection, implementation, performance, stability, and limitations. You’ll perform quantitative testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, back-testing, and other validation activities. You’ll review model monitoring frameworks and help identify performance deterioration, emerging risks, and areas requiring remediation. You’ll evaluate model documentation for completeness, clarity, reproducibility, and alignment with model risk management standards. You’ll provide effective challenges to model developers and business stakeholders while maintaining constructive working relationships. You’ll communicate validation findings, model risks, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. You’ll support model governance processes, including model inventory, risk tiering, validation scheduling, issue tracking, and remediation follow-up. You’ll partner with Risk, Compliance, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and other teams to strengthen model controls and governance practices. You’ll help improve model risk frameworks, validation methodologies, documentation standards, monitoring practices, and governance processes. You’ll use data and analytics to identify trends and emerging risks across the model portfolio. You’ll look for thoughtful ways to use AI tools to improve research, analysis, documentation, testing, and model risk workflows while maintaining appropriate human review. You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a rigorous and curious quantitative professional who enjoys understanding how models work, where they can fail, and how their risks should be managed. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking detailed questions, and supporting your conclusions with clear analysis. You combine technical depth with strong judgment and communication skills. You can work independently, explain complex quantitative issues clearly, and build credibility with model developers and senior stakeholders. You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 5+ years of experience in data science, model validation, model risk management, quantitative risk, statistics, or a related field. Strong understanding of statistical modeling and machine learning techniques such as logistic regression, gradient boosting, decision trees, neural networks, or similar methods. Strong understanding of how defaults, recoveries, prepayments, loan seasoning, and macroeconomic conditions influence consumer loan portfolio losses and cash flows. Experience developing or validating consumer credit loss forecasting models using methods such as vintage/cohort analysis, roll-rate or transition models, survival analysis, time-series models, or probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD), and exposure at default (EAD) frameworks.Strong proficiency in Python, R, SQL, or similar quantitative programming tools. Experience working with large datasets and performing advanced statistical analysis, model testing, or performance evaluation. Strong understanding of model validation techniques, performance metrics, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, stability analysis, and ongoing monitoring. Experience evaluating model assumptions, data quality, limitations, implementation, and business use. Experience independently leading complex analytical or validation work from scoping through final conclusions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical findings and explain complex model risks clearly. Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with model developers, Risk, Compliance, and senior stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience in model risk management or independent model validation. Experience with credit risk, fraud risk, consumer lending, fintech, banking, or another regulated financial services environment. Familiarity with model governance frameworks, model inventories, risk tiering, validation schedules, issue management, or regulatory expectations. Experience validating machine learning or AI models. Experience developing or validating liquidity, funding, or cash-flow forecasting models, including evaluating funding needs and liquidity under stress scenarios. Familiarity with capital markets models used for loan valuation or securitization, including assessing how key assumptions affect valuations and projected cash flows.Experience with AWS, SageMaker, Databricks, or other cloud-based analytics and modeling platforms. Experience with Spark, PySpark, Hive, or other large-scale data technologies. Master’s degree or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Finance, or another quantitative discipline. Experience using AI-assisted tools to support research, coding, documentation, validation, or quantitative analysis. Our AI Mindset We b uild with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together . Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: India Benefits: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance Provident Fund Life & Accident Insurance Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-data-scientist-model-risk-management-r14365

items.description: Collage Group is the only cultural intelligence engine that fuses consumer, industry, and brand data to provide brands with insights on the why behind consumers’ behaviors – so they can act quickly to fuel revenue and brand growth. Powered by 28B points of data and AI workflows, we’re helping 250+ of the world’s largest brands win with key growth audiences. Collage Group is seeking a Research Operations Manager to join our Custom Insights & Strategy team in our mission to uncover hidden truths and immersive human insights that propel brands forward. In this role, you will own the technical execution and operational backbone of our custom market research engagements - from programming complex surveys in Decipher and managing fieldwork to ensuring rigorous data quality. Beyond core research operations, you will act as an innovation leader and champion to help evaluate and implement new tools to improve research workflows and expand capabilities. Our team is looking for someone who is excited about the opportunities AI creates, enjoys thinking creatively about research methodologies and processes, and brings enthusiasm and initiative to tackling the changing landscape of our industry. Note: This is a consumer market research programming position and not a data science, engineering, or coding role. Responsibilities Survey Programming: Own end-to-end survey programming in Decipher across a variety of custom quantitative study types, including complex logic, quota generation, translation integration, and multi-media asset management. Work closely with research team members to ensure survey design and programming supports project objectives and downstream tasks (e.g., hidden questions to facilitate chart-ready tables). Field Management & Vendor Coordination: Manage survey fielding, overseeing panel / sample vendor communication, quotas, incidence, survey traffic, and project costs to ensure on-time and on-budget delivery. Work with project teams to proactively troubleshoot any timeline or budget concerns. Project Management & Team Collaboration: Oversee operational timelines across concurrent studies, proactively flagging capacity, technical, or fielding risks early and collaborating with project teams to proactively troubleshoot issues. Collaborate closely with team members to ensure collective success and client satisfaction. Data Quality: Perform rigorous Quality Assurance (QA/QC) on survey links, raw datasets / data cleaning, and data tables to guarantee accuracy and data integrity. Identify new ways of preventing bots and optimize data quality. Research & Reporting Support: Work with research team members to support broader project deliverables as needed, including building data visualizations and charts in PowerPoint, formatting data tables, and proofing / QC on client deliverables. AI & Workflow Innovation: Act as a team champion for technological evolution by investigating, testing, and integrating new tools and processes that help maintain Collage’s competitiveness in the industry. Explore ways to expand the role of research operations by proactively identifying ways to streamline workflows and expand the team’s technical capabilities. Experience 3-7+ years of demonstrated experience in consumer market research operations, survey programming, and field management (agency, supplier, or consultancy side preferred) Required: Hands-on, advanced proficiency in Decipher survey programming (including complex logic, quotas, and advanced design - conjoint, maxdiff, turf, etc.) Strong knowledge of quantitative survey methodologies, sampling, and data management Experience working directly with panel vendors and directly overseeing quotas, incidence, timelines, and budgets Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with comfort handling banners / tabs / data tables, chart-building / formatting, and data QC Exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational habits, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent timelines and deadlines Creative problem-solver who thrives in both self-directed technical execution and collaborative, cross-functional team environments Genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for evolving team workflows and technical capabilities with emerging AI technologies and new market research innovations Preferred: Familiarity with AI-enabled survey programming, scripting, or research automation tools preferred Experience with SQL, Python, SPSS, or R is a plus Spanish language proficiency is a plus Job Location: Fully Remote Target Compensation: $68,000 – $88,000. Our target hiring range typically falls near the midpoint of this band, with the upper end reserved for candidates who bring extensive relevant experience, specialized skills, or exceed the core qualifications of the role. Details regarding our Benefits can be found on our Careers Page. All full time direct employees must be authorized to work in the United States, and must be US-based . Please note that while we are happy to hire remote unless otherwise stated in the job description, we are only able to employ people in the following US States: CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, MD, MA, MN, MO, NJ, NY, NC, OH, PA, RI, TN, TX, VA and DC. Important: If you have not interviewed directly with an authorized representative of Collage and you receive a job offer, do not respond or provide any personal information. This is likely a fraudulent attempt. Collage will never request sensitive information (such as your Social Security number, banking details, or passwords) before a formal interview process. About Us: Collage is the only AI-enabled cultural intelligence engine that provides brands with curated, actionable, cultural insights to accelerate revenue growth. Only Collage fuses consumer, brand and industry insights from 26 billion primary data points to provide brands with unparalleled depth of insights on the why behind consumers’ behaviors. The combination of the always-on, easy to use, updated daily tech platform with the best-in-class cultural strategists provides a unique competitive advantage for the world’s leading brands. Collage enables marketers and insights professionals to futureproof their brands, identify and win with the fastest-growing segments, increase brand resonance and loyalty, and authentically activate across all the marketing levers. Founded in 2009, culture has always been at the company’s core. Collage is a National Minority Supplier Development Council (NMSDC) certified minority-owned small business. Collage Group provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. Offer About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. items.description: Design Headquarters: Costa Rica, Remote Our Mission: 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner Business Solutions Partner — GTM & Finance Systems Location Costa Rica Function / Dept Business Technology — Enterprise Applications Reports to Director, Enterprise Applications Position Summary 6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals. This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes. Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. Working closely with the Enterprise AI Engineering team, you will translate complex business challenges into technical requirements and implementation plans while independently delivering design prototypes and lightweight solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Workato, and other approved enterprise AI technologies. A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences. This is a growth role within a new Enterprise AI career track. You will work under the guidance of the Lead Enterprise AI Business Solutions Engineer and will be measured on business outcomes, including adoption, productivity gains, automation impact, cost avoidance, and process improvements. As you progress, you will take increasing ownership of a portfolio of business capabilities, including identifying, developing, delivering and maturing measurable AI-driven value. Responsibilities Tool Inventory & AI Efficiency Discovery Build and maintain the AI and tool inventory for your assigned function: owner, use case, active users, annual cost, renewal date, AI features in use, contract exit terms and replacement feasibility. Find where AI features we already pay for are unused, duplicated or overlap with other tools, and document the findings. Track renewal dates and flag every contract at least 120 days before the notice date so a build-vs-buy decision can be made in time. Run discovery interviews and working sessions with stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done, and surface the business problem behind the requested feature. Map current processes and estimate the time spent, the number of people involved and the frequency, so every opportunity has a baseline. Build-vs-Buy Analysis & Business Cases Prepare the inputs for build-vs-buy analysis: what the tool does, how deeply it is integrated, compliance burden, usage compared with cost, and realistic replacement scope. Contribute to business cases that compare three-year build, run and support cost with vendor cost, working with the Lead and with Enterprise AI Engineers on the build side. Agree baselines with business owners before work starts and record their sign-off, so savings and hours returned can be validated later. Recommend which candidates to pursue first, using renewal timing, savings potential and build feasibility. Prototyping & Applied AI Build prototypes and simple agents with Claude and Copilot to test whether a tool, or part of a workflow, can be replaced or improved. Write clear, build-ready context for Enterprise AI Engineers: the process, the data involved, example inputs and outputs, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Help define evaluation criteria, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths before anything reaches production. Design the process around the AI: what changes for the seller, agent or analyst, what training is needed and how exceptions are handled. Bring AI fluency to stakeholders: help non-technical teams understand what these tools can and cannot reliably do, and set realistic expectations. Stakeholder Partnership Serve as the named Business Solutions Partner for your assigned function, and the point of contact for intake, priorities and status. Translate business needs into clear, buildable stories and acceptance criteria, and translate technical trade-offs back into language stakeholders can act on. Keep stakeholders informed on what is changing, what is being built and what may move more slowly during the transition. Escalate misalignment, scope drift and risk early to the Lead before they become executive issues. Hands-On Salesforce & Delivery Configure and deliver declarative Salesforce solutions (flows, validation rules, record types, page layouts, permission sets, reports and dashboards) for small requests, with guidance on larger ones. Understand Apex, integrations and data model implications well enough to scope work accurately and hold a credible technical conversation with engineers. Own UAT for your function: define test scenarios, coordinate stakeholder testing and support release sign-off. Maintain accurate documentation of processes, solution designs and system dependencies. Measurement & Ways of Working Track adoption (percent of target users active) for anything shipped in your function, and report what is working and what should be retired. Report hours returned and spend avoided using the agreed baseline, and flag figures that are not yet validated. Work in the team’s agentic delivery model: use the intake agent, async standups and automated sprint summaries instead of status meetings, and give feedback on what to improve. Contribute to team standards for the inventory, business case template and requirements. Skills & Experience Required 2–4 years of relevant experience as a business analyst, business solution partner, business systems analyst, Salesforce administrator or operations analyst supporting business stakeholders, preferably at a SaaS company. Hands-on Salesforce administration experience (Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud), including Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets and reporting. Salesforce Certified Administrator, or obtained within the first six months in the role. Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar, with solid prompt design and an understanding of their limits. Strong spreadsheet and data fluency: cleaning data, building summaries and sizing a problem. Process mapping and structured interviewing skills. Clear written and spoken English; able to present findings to U.S.-based stakeholders. Must be located in Costa Rica and able to maintain consistent working overlap with U.S. business hours. Preferred Experience putting an AI or automation solution into a live business process, even a small one, and measuring the result. Familiarity with GTM processes (lead to cash, pipeline, forecasting) or Support operations (case management, routing, knowledge), or with Finance, Legal or Partner operations. Basic financial literacy: reading a vendor cost, comparing build and run cost, and calculating a payback period. Exposure to SQL, APIs or low-code tools; interest in using Claude Code under guidance. Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Agentforce Specialist. Experience in an Agile team; familiarity with Jira, Asana or similar. Bilingual English/Spanish. What we value Curiosity and a bias to build and test, not just to document. Honesty about what is validated and what is an estimate. Comfort with change, since this track is new and will keep evolving. How This Role Is Measured Accuracy and completeness of the tool inventory for your function. Percent of renewals in scope identified and reviewed at least 120 days before the notice date. Prototype quality, as rated by the stakeholder and the engineering lead. Hours returned and spend avoided on initiatives you support, validated by the business owner. Adoption of anything shipped in your function. What Success Looks Like First 90 days Inventory for your function is complete and reviewed with business owners. Renewal calendar for your tools is documented, with the next three renewals ranked by savings potential. Two or more stakeholder discovery sessions completed, with baselines drafted for the top opportunities. First prototype built with Claude or Copilot and reviewed with the Lead and an engineer. First year Your stakeholder group treats you as its partner for systems and AI work and routes requests to you rather than escalating. At least two prototypes evaluated end to end, and at least one taken to production with Enterprise AI Engineers, with measured impact. At least one initiative with a documented baseline, business-owner sign-off and a validated hours-returned or spend-avoided number. Renewals for your function reviewed before notice dates, with a documented decision on each. You are operating toward IC4: leading a build-vs-buy analysis from discovery to recommendation with little guidance. Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. Equal Opportunity Employer: 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com . We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. A ll email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain . We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments . If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@ 6sense.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/6sense-business-solutions-partner-enterprise-ai

With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels. Senior Manager, Client Analytics Partnership - EMEA The Senior Manager of Client Analytics Partnership for EMEA leads a team of individual contributors responsible for developing client measurement strategies, delivering actionable insights and building strategic partnerships that support growth across the EMEA region. This role is a people manager role and also requires hands-on client support on high-priority client partnerships. The Sr. Manager identifies geo-specific measurement needs, shapes strategies, and leads global testing and reporting initiatives, ensuring the Client Analytics Partnership team delivers impactful insights and data-driven strategic client support while fostering innovation and team development. This role reports to the VP of Global Data & Analytics. StackAdapt is a remote-first company. Candidates should be based in London or the surrounding area, with regular travel to meet clients. What you will be doing: Lead the Client Analytics Partnership (CAP) team, ensuring strategic goals are met and pursuing market development. Oversee the development, education, and implementation of market-specific measurement strategies, testing plans, learning agendas, and reporting adoption across AM and AE teams. Provide direct support on high-priority client partnerships or vendor relationships that lead to overall team capability development. Help support recruitment and GTM of prioritised initiatives to feed the pipeline of potential case study candidates. Translate regional needs to scaled solutions teams or product team to develop client deliverables that meet their business/marketing reporting objectives. Demonstrate and incorporate AI and automation as the foundation for scaling best practices and analytics support. Influence StackAdapts EMEA market strategy by addressing repeated client reporting needs and anticipating future challenges. Identify and develop best practices that align with different verticals and business objectives, ensuring scalable client measurement solutions Serve as the primary measurement consultant for Sales and Client Service Leads and engages in leadership-level conversations for EMEA markets Advises on measurement strategy and planning in key new business development, and directly participates in client pitches Collaborates with NORAM counterparts to create enterprise-level measurement tactics and ensure efficient division of projects across the regions for collective efforts. Represent EMEA market needs to identify region-specific nuances in GTM materials. Partners closely with the scaled solutions, product and technical engineering team, though this role does not manage data engineering, pipelines, or dashboard development. What you’ll bring to the table: 7 to 9 years of experience in a similar role, preferably within the digital media or programmatic advertising landscape servicing clients. Experience leading and developing client-facing analytics or measurement professionals. Experience in guiding teams through measurement strategies, test designs and learning objectives to set KPIs. Knowledge of industry-standard performance metrics and media KPIs. Knowledge of regional ad policies and guardrails on privacy and data governance laws. Experience working with internal teams, cross-functional partners, and supporting client relationships. Proficiency in using reporting tools (such as Tableau, PowerBI, ThoughtSpot, BigQuery, and Google Analytics) and media buying platforms for data analysis. The ability to translate and articulate complex measurement concepts to both executive C-suite stakeholders and technical engineering audiences. Expert understanding of client servicing and campaign management. Deep understanding of measurement methodologies and strategies, including incrementality, brand and engagement lift, test design, attribution models (including the limitations of last-touch attribution and application of multi-touch attribution), and marketing mix modelling (MMM). We do not ask c andidates about current or prior salary history, and we will not use such information, if volunteered, in setting an offer. This range represents base salary only. Depending on the role, candidates may also be eligible for additional compensation such as annual bonuses, commissions, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits package. items.description: At NerdWallet , our mission is to provide clarity for all of life's financial decisions. Data Science plays a critical role in delivering on that mission, helping us better understand our consumers, personalize their experiences, and connect them with the financial products that best meet their needs. We’re growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) to join us as a foundational member of our new team. You’ll help shape and advance our machine learning capabilities across consumer personalization, predictive modeling, and performance marketing, with a real voice in how we work from day one. Together, we’re building an inclusive, supportive team culture where we lift each other up and succeed together to drive business impact across the organization. In this role, you will lead the development of production-grade machine learning solutions that power some of NerdWallet's most critical business decisions. From predicting customer lifetime value and scoring incoming leads in real time to developing recommendation engines that connect consumers with the right financial products, your work will have a direct impact on how we acquire, engage, and monetize our customer relationships. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone with deep expertise in applied machine learning, production ML systems, and the Databricks ecosystem. As a foundational member of the team, you’ll partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Analytics to translate complex business problems into scalable ML solutions, while helping establish the technical standards and best practices for machine learning across NerdWallet. Where you can make an impact: Build Predictive Models That Drive Business Growth Lead the end-to-end development of advanced machine learning models focused on customer lifetime value (LTV), conversion propensity, lead quality, and revenue optimization. Translate model predictions into actionable signals that improve marketing investment decisions, customer acquisition efficiency, and long-term profitability. Advance Personalization & Recommendation Systems Develop recommendation and ranking models that identify the most relevant financial products for individual consumers based on their needs, behaviors, and predicted propensity to engage or convert. Explore and implement approaches such as propensity modeling, learning-to-rank, and next-best-product recommendations to improve customer engagement and cross-sell opportunities. Collaborate with Product and Marketing to integrate predictive intelligence into consumer experiences and personalized communications. Establish Best-in-Class ML Practices Leverage Databricks and MLflow to develop, train, deploy, monitor, and manage machine learning models at scale. Establish robust DS practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, feature engineering, automated training pipelines, model monitoring, and reproducibility. Define standards for model performance, reliability, retraining, and production readiness, including monitoring for data drift and model degradation. Design and evaluate experiments to measure the incremental business impact of deployed models and continuously improve their effectiveness. Serve as a technical leader within Data Science, mentoring other practitioners, influencing architectural decisions, and elevating engineering and modeling standards across the organization. Your experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Applied Machine Learning, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of developing and deploying ML solutions that drive measurable business impact. Deep, hands-on experience with Databricks, including building and managing production machine learning workflows using MLflow and the Databricks ML ecosystem. Please note: this role requires hands-on Databricks experience specifically, and experience with similar platforms is not a substitute. Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with extensive experience using modern machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. Strong understanding of supervised learning, predictive modeling, classification, regression, ranking, and model evaluation techniques. Practical experience designing scalable batch and/or real-time inference systems, with an understanding of latency, reliability, and performance trade-offs. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, modular code design, and CI/CD practices for machine learning. Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous technical initiatives from problem definition through deployment and business impact measurement. Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, conversion improvement, customer lifetime value, and marketing efficiency. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing technical direction and working effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams. Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Where: This is a remote position and a person can be located anywhere in Canada (with the exception of Quebec). NerdWallet is proud to be a remote-first company! We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family. What we offer: Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?) items.description: At NerdWallet , our mission is to provide clarity for all of life's financial decisions. Data Science plays a critical role in delivering on that mission, helping us better understand our consumers, personalize their experiences, and connect them with the financial products that best meet their needs. We’re growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) to join us as a foundational member of our new team. You’ll help shape and advance our machine learning capabilities across consumer personalization, predictive modeling, and performance marketing, with a real voice in how we work from day one. Together, we’re building an inclusive, supportive team culture where we lift each other up and succeed together to drive business impact across the organization. In this role, you will lead the development of production-grade machine learning solutions that power some of NerdWallet's most critical business decisions. From predicting customer lifetime value and scoring incoming leads in real time to developing recommendation engines that connect consumers with the right financial products, your work will have a direct impact on how we acquire, engage, and monetize our customer relationships. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone with deep expertise in applied machine learning, production ML systems, and the Databricks ecosystem. As a foundational member of the team, you’ll partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Analytics to translate complex business problems into scalable ML solutions, while helping establish the technical standards and best practices for machine learning across NerdWallet. Where you can make an impact: Build Predictive Models That Drive Business Growth Lead the end-to-end development of advanced machine learning models focused on customer lifetime value (LTV), conversion propensity, lead quality, and revenue optimization. Translate model predictions into actionable signals that improve marketing investment decisions, customer acquisition efficiency, and long-term profitability. Advance Personalization & Recommendation Systems Develop recommendation and ranking models that identify the most relevant financial products for individual consumers based on their needs, behaviors, and predicted propensity to engage or convert. Explore and implement approaches such as propensity modeling, learning-to-rank, and next-best-product recommendations to improve customer engagement and cross-sell opportunities. Collaborate with Product and Marketing to integrate predictive intelligence into consumer experiences and personalized communications. Establish Best-in-Class ML Practices Leverage Databricks and MLflow to develop, train, deploy, monitor, and manage machine learning models at scale. Establish robust DS practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, feature engineering, automated training pipelines, model monitoring, and reproducibility. Define standards for model performance, reliability, retraining, and production readiness, including monitoring for data drift and model degradation. Design and evaluate experiments to measure the incremental business impact of deployed models and continuously improve their effectiveness. Serve as a technical leader within Data Science, mentoring other practitioners, influencing architectural decisions, and elevating engineering and modeling standards across the organization. Your experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Applied Machine Learning, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of developing and deploying ML solutions that drive measurable business impact. Deep, hands-on experience with Databricks, including building and managing production machine learning workflows using MLflow and the Databricks ML ecosystem. Please note: this role requires hands-on Databricks experience specifically, and experience with similar platforms is not a substitute. Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with extensive experience using modern machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. Strong understanding of supervised learning, predictive modeling, classification, regression, ranking, and model evaluation techniques. Practical experience designing scalable batch and/or real-time inference systems, with an understanding of latency, reliability, and performance trade-offs. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, modular code design, and CI/CD practices for machine learning. Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous technical initiatives from problem definition through deployment and business impact measurement. Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, conversion improvement, customer lifetime value, and marketing efficiency. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing technical direction and working effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams. Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Where: This role will be remote (based in the U.S.). We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family. What we offer: Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?) Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care Mental health support Paid sabbatical after 5 years for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge, and pursue their interests Health and Dependent Care FSA and HSA Plan with monthly NerdWallet contribution Monthly Wellness Stipend, Cell Phone Stipend, and Wifi Stipend (Only remote Nerds are eligible for the Wifi Stipend) Work from home equipment stipend and co-working space subsidy (Only remote Nerds are eligible for these stipends) Have Some Fun! items.description: Product Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . We are looking for an Analytics Engineering Manager II, Core Data Science to help improve the quality and velocity of data science at Pinterest. You will shape the future of the people-facing and business-facing products we build by creating rock-solid data foundations and tooling, and by leading a high-performance team that partners closely with our Core Data Science organization. What you'll do: Build, inspire, and grow a high-performance, diverse team of analytics engineers with an inclusive culture. Develop best practices for instrumentation and experimentation and communicate those to product engineering teams. Build and prototype AI tools and analysis pipelines iteratively to provide insights at scale while developing comprehensive knowledge of data structures and metrics, advocating for changes where needed. Use AI to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and iteration—drafting pipelines, exploring approaches, and automating repeatable documentation and QA—while applying judgment and verification to ensure correctness and quality. Work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers to build tools and processes that enable self-service of key datasets, insights, and metric investigations. Contribute to comprehensive documentation of tools and datasets, and drive the strategy for better data quality and data democratization within Pinterest. Work cross-functionally to build and communicate key insights, collaborating with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers to help build the next experiences on Pinterest. What we're looking for: 6+ years of experience working with data in a fast-paced, data-driven environment, including experience managing engineers. Ability to manipulate large data sets with high dimensionality and complexity; fluency in SQL (or other database languages) and a scripting language (Python or R), including nested data structure manipulation, windowing functions, query optimization, and data partitioning techniques. Experience conducting workflow orchestration and ETL/ELT with huge, complicated datasets and handling DAG data dependencies. Consistent track record of supplying analytics solutions to existing teams, with the ability to take open-ended goals and scope them into defined, impactful objectives. A team player able to partner with cross-functional leadership to quickly turn insights into actions, and an accountable operator who proactively identifies project opportunities amid competing priorities. Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve speed and quality in your day-to-day workflow, with a strong track record of critical evaluation and verification of AI-assisted work (testing, source-checking, data validation, peer review). High integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI, and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables. Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. Desired but not required: Experience in automation, anomaly detection, or infrastructure/workflow optimization. Experience building internal tooling to maximize engineering velocity. Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. In-Office Requirement Statement: We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/month and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country. #LI-REMOTE #LI-AG8 At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise. Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here . US based applicants only $177,185 — $364,795 USD Our Commitment to Inclusion: Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support. By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pinterest-manager-ii-engineering-analytics-engineering-core-data-science

Po
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: NYC, Remote Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences. Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system. Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI. Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. What’s the opportunity? The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Intercom uses data and insights to drive evidence-based decision-making. We're a team of data scientists and product researchers who use data - both big and small - to unlock actionable insights about our customers, our products and our business. We generate insights that build customer empathy, drive product strategy and shape products that deliver real value to our customers. We’re now seeing strong demand for data scientists who can apply their expertise directly with our most strategic customers. As a Forward Deployed Data Scientist, you’ll embed with customers to build Enterprise-grade Fin deployments. You’ll play a pivotal role in transforming how our most strategic customers scale customer support — working closely with them and our go-to-market teams to design, build, and implement data-driven solutions that unlock measurable impact. You’ll also feed insights from these frontline deployments back into Intercom’s product and strategy — helping shape the future of AI customer service. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, is energized by solving complex, real-world problems with data, and is motivated by seeing their work translate into both customer impact and product evolution. What will I be doing? Drive the adoption of Fin by helping customers automate and scale their support operations. Embed with strategic customers to understand their support workflows, data, and business challenges — to identify and implement opportunities where AI can deliver measurable impact. Steer customers toward best practices in measurement and AI adoption to realize the full value of Fin. Partner closely with Sales, Success, and Product to deliver seamless customer experiences and successful deployments, and to create feedback loops that shape product development. Use AI to prototype, test, and scale data-driven solutions, building tools that make us faster and more effective in driving Fin adoption and customer impact. What skills do I need? Proven ability to apply data science in real-world business contexts to drive measurable outcomes. Strong collaboration mindset; skilled at working across Sales, Success, Product, and Engineering. High adaptability and ownership: able to shift between deep technical analysis and high-level strategic framing. Excellent communication skills, both technical and non-technical. Rapid prototyping with systems thinking: you know when a customer needs a fast, bespoke answer, and when to build something others will keep using. Excellent SQL and production-aware Python, you write code other people can run, not just code that runs once and are experienced applying analytical and statistical methods to real business problems. Experience with AI/ML evaluation, LLM-driven applications, or conversational AI. Willing to travel and work on-site with customers to build deep relationships and uncover insights firsthand. Bonus skills and attributes Experience in technical consulting, customer-facing analytics, or SaaS product data science. Experience reframing the problem, not just solving it, you've spotted when the question you were handed wasn't the right one, and changed what got worked on. Experience applying AI to scale the data science workflow. *Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required. The base salary range for candidates within the New York Area is $206,000- $229,000. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). #LI-Hybrid Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers . Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Policies Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week. We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values . Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fin-senior-forward-deployed-data-scientist

Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, this person will take a Deal Desk that already has a foundation
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote, United States JOB OVERVIEW The Senior Deal Desk Manager is a senior individual contributor role responsible for how Legion prices, structures, approves, and contracts global deals across every region Legion sells into. Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, this person will take a Deal Desk that already has a foundation and scale it into a fast, compliant, AI-native function — through better systems and automation, not more headcount. The ideal candidate has built Deal Desk operations from scratch at an early-stage or growth-stage SaaS company and knows what to standardize, what to automate, and what to leave flexible. They work AI-first: when a process is slow, their first move is to build an agent, a tool, or an automation. This person will serve as the connective tissue between Sales, Finance, Legal, and Client Management, helping to streamline quote-to-close workflows, enforce pricing governance, and accelerate revenue realization. RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES Own deal structuring for complex new business, expansion, and renewal deals, partnering with sales leaders on creative structures that protect margin and policy. Own the approval matrix, discount guardrails, non-standard terms policy, and SLAs, with accountability for approval cycle time and quote accuracy. Support global deals end to end, including multi-currency pricing, multiple contracting entities, regional terms and tax considerations, and approval cycles that span time zones. Partner with Legal and Finance on contract standards, regional contracting requirements (data protection terms, local entity paper, currency/FX policy), revenue recognition alignment, and the order-to-cash handoff. Design Deal Desk workflows with AI at the core — for example, automated deal pre-screening against pricing and packaging policy, AI-generated deal summaries for approvers, and AI-assisted redline review against Legal’s playbook. Build and iterate working tools — pricing calculators, quoting tools, and approval automations — using AI-assisted development. Set guardrails for AI in deal workflows, including human-in-the-loop approvals, appropriate data handling, and a clear audit trail. Own and evolve Legion’s quoting and contracting stack (CPQ, CLM, DocuSign) with Salesforce as the system of record, including tools built in-house, and ensure workflows handle currencies, entities, and regional templates without manual workarounds. Develop reporting and dashboards that give Sales, Finance, and executive leadership visibility into discount trends, packaging adherence, approval turnaround times, and the impact of automation. Present deal analysis and insights directly in executive pricing reviews and forecast discussions. Partner closely with RevOps, Product Marketing, and Finance to operationalize pricing and packaging changes. Build the deal calculators, edge-case rules, and sales playbooks that bring new pricing to life in the field. REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, or Sales Operations within B2B SaaS companies, including 3+ years owning Deal Desk operations end to end. Demonstrated experience building Deal Desk processes from the ground up at an early-stage or growth-stage company, with the ability to walk through what was built, in what order, and what you would do differently. Hands-on AI practitioner who has used AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Agentforce) to automate real Deal Desk or RevOps work, with an example to share. Hands-on experience structuring and contracting international SaaS deals across multiple regions, currencies, and legal entities. Deep expertise in SaaS pricing — subscription, usage-based, consumption-based, and hybrid models — along with discount governance and contracting best practices. Experience implementing CPQ and CLM systems; strong modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets. Proven ability to influence without authority across Sales, Finance, Legal, and executive leadership, including saying no to senior sellers while keeping the relationship intact. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES Experience launching AI, agentic, or data product SKUs, or partner and marketplace deal structures. Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM Experience in WFM, HCM, or enterprise SaaS selling to retail, hospitality, or healthcare. Operates with a builder’s mindset — proactive, resourceful, and eager to create clarity from ambiguity with a high degree of independence. Strong personal ownership, high integrity, and a focus on outcomes over activity. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Thrives in a collaborative, mission-driven environment and embraces change with enthusiasm. Flexibility to cover urgent deal approvals across time zones, especially at quarter-end. SALARY RANGE: Base Salary Range $100,000 - $140,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY ABOUT LEGION Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and is designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is composed of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones. For more information, visit https://legion.co COMPENSATION & BENEFITS At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. Benefits include, but are not limited to: Health Benefits Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Parental Leave Equity Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Monthly Lunch on Legion EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. How We Determine What We Pay As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/sx6tzFKwyUTPcquYzQkRFu/jobs-at-movement-labs Movement Labs is an incubator and consulting firm that uses technology, data, and experimentation to stop fascism and build progressive power. We help progressives win and defeat MAGA extremists through year-round work grounded in research and real-world testing. Our team partners with leading advocacy groups, grassroots organizers, and electoral campaigns to develop innovative tactics, win elections, and shift power for the long term. As the R&D powerhouse for the progressive movement, we’ve run over 100 randomized control trials (RCTs) on voter behavior and helped hundreds of organizations increase their impact. We work hard, and the environment evolves rapidly. We are adaptable, nimble, and shift quickly as needed to meet the moment. We are looking for candidates that thrive in this type of environment. We are looking for 2 roles, Senior and Mid-level Data Engineers to join the Tech department. You will be a part of an 8-person data engineering team, and will have a lot of ownership and ability to make an impact. You’ll work cross-functionally in a collaborative, startup-like environment. What the work looks like for our data team: Design and implement scalable data architecture for targeting and engagement Serve as technical partner to program teams Extend our foundational datasets to facilitate new outreach strategies Load-test our systems to prepare for elections Maintain key datasets for polling images and precinct cross-matching Develop standardized experimental frameworks for testing campaign effectiveness Build AI tooling that makes our own team faster — QC agents for data deliveries, the evals to trust them, and context systems that keep our repos self-documenting Our data team’s work mixes greenfield builds, pragmatic plumbing, incident response, and operational work. The relative mix shifts with the political calendar. This role is fully remote. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. Responsibilities Shape the pipelines and integrations feeding our RCT platform and our foundational voter datasets: the APIs, replication, federation layers, experiment randomization, and the failure modes that come with running data systems for hundreds of partner organizations on a non-negotiable political calendar Extend our data platform and orchestration layer, and optimize it for cost, runtime, and reliability so it holds up during the elections, with millions of outreach attempts Lead projects that span multiple systems and teams — scoping, designing, and driving them to real milestones Hold the bar on quality — test and validate your own work, review teammates' code, and mentor through that review Document and communicate — make your systems understandable to teammates, stakeholders, and non-engineers Rotate through on-call and rapid response, including evenings and weekends during high-stakes moments like election cycles Passionate about progressive politics and leveraging data, technology, organizing and research to build political power 3-6+ years of experience (Senior or Mid-level) in designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and integrations Strong proficiency in SQL and Python Experience building production software across a modern data stack — cloud data warehouses (BigQuery or similar), a transformation framework like dbt, and an orchestrator like Dagster or Airflow A track record of leading technical work across multiple systems or teams, and scoping ambiguous problems end-to-end Sound judgment about when to refactor, when to ship pragmatically, and how to leave systems better than you found them Strong written communication — you document what you build and can explain complex systems to non-engineers Genuine
