items.description: About Valdera : At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly. Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you. Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together. Role Description: We are hiring a C hemical Data Scientist to build and maintain the pipelines that keep Valdera's supplier and chemical product data accurate, current, and structured — the foundation every buyer and supplier relies on across Valdera's procurement platform. Data quality plays a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect to be matched with the right suppliers and accurate specs on the first try. Delivering that depends on clean, current data — CAS numbers, specifications, certifications, and regulatory documents pulled from thousands of inconsistent, often messy sources. This requires strong data engineering fundamentals and a working knowledge of chemical industry data. For example, you might take dozens of differently structured chemical supplier catalogs and turn them into one clean, standardized product database. You will take ownership of the full data pipeline — from scrapers and ETL workflows to data cleaning, matching, and classification models that connect suppliers to buyer requirements. You're energized by messy, real-world data and confident partnering with Supplier Management and Engineering to close coverage gaps. As a data-obsessed professional, you're dedicated to the accuracy our buyers and suppliers depend on. Role Responsibilities: Design and build pipelines to collect supplier data and chemical product information (specifications, CAS numbers, certifications, SDS/regulatory documents, NAICS classification of manufacturing plants) from supplier sites, distributor catalogs, trade databases, and other public and semi-structured sources Develop and maintain web scrapers and automated ETL workflows to keep supplier and product data current at scale Clean, normalize, and reconcile inconsistent supplier data into structured, standardized formats suitable for internal tools and analytics Apply chemical domain knowledge to validate and enrich data — resolving product names, CAS numbers, synonyms, and specifications across suppliers Evaluate and improve matching and classification models to map suppliers and products to buyer requirements, and to identify overlapping or equivalent chemical offerings Partner with Supplier Management and Engineering to define data quality standards, identify gaps in supplier coverage, and prioritize new data sources. Own pipeline health and data quality, and drive the KPIs that measure overall data coverage Experience & Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in a data science, data engineering, or applied data role, ideally with exposure to messy, real-world or industrial datasets. Working knowledge of chemistry or chemical industry data — comfort with CAS numbers, chemical properties, SDS documents, NAICS classification, and supplier certifications Strong Python skills, with experience building web scrapers and data pipelines Experience with data cleaning and normalization at scale, and a good eye for spotting inconsistencies in unstructured data Familiarity with building or applying matching, deduplication, or classification models (traditional ML or LLM-based approaches) Hands-on experience using AI tools and LLMs to accelerate data extraction, enrichment, or engineering workflows Startup mindset with a strong sense of ownership — comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, remote environment with ambiguous, evolving priorities Compensation Additional Information Salary Range: Salary ranges are determined by multiple factors, including the labor market, market compensation bands, internal parity, and budget considerations. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s individual skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the requirements of the role. Benefits: Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. You will be provided a more detailed breakdown of your options prior to joining Valdera. Equal Opportunity Employer Statement: Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and celebrate a culture that values varied perspectives, skills, and experiences. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) About the Role: Maven is seeking a Manager, Payments & Reconciliation to lead the end-to-end financial operations and reconciliation framework across our enterprise and consumer programs. Reporting into the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team, you will architect a robust, scalable payment integrity program. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of payment funding, from accurate invoicing and money movement oversight to complex account reconciliation, while partnering with Product/Engineering to build automated financial controls that ensure operational excellence at scale. As a Manager, Payments & Reconciliation at Maven, you will: Oversee the end-to-end movement of payment funds across Maven’s Enterprise and Consumer programs, ensuring transaction accuracy, timely disbursement, and integrity across the full funding pipeline, including fee-for-service claims payments. Own client and payer invoicing for payment funding programs and the timely reconciliation of complex claims funding account transactions and balances, ensuring paid claims tie back to funding. Monitor clinic, provider, and fee-for-service claims payments against contracted rates and timeliness standards, identifying overpayments, underpayments, and SLA gaps, and partnering with operations to resolve root causes and recover funds. Manage Maven's floated benefit funding program, including tracking outstanding float balances, driving timely recoupment from clients and payers, and escalating aging exposure to Finance. Lead cross-functional root cause analyses on financial discrepancies and drive continuous process improvements that prevent billing errors, optimize cash flow, and increase the accuracy and scalability of the payments and invoicing function. Partner with Finance during the month-end close process, including supporting the preparation of detailed bank reconciliations, owning reporting deliverables and assisting with analyses around collections risk. Act as the financial subject matter expert for Client Success, equipping CSMs with detailed reconciliation insights and structural solutions to resolve billing disputes and optimize the client funding experience. Act as the business owner for funding tools, collaborating with Product and Engineering to design application enhancements, resolve bugs, and automate financial workflows. Establish and uphold strong internal controls and accountability standards to support audit readiness and financial compliance. We’re looking for you to bring: 6+ years in revenue cycle management, financial analysis, or payment operations, with direct experience in payment funding, fee for service, settlements, reconciliation, claims funding accounts or healthcare payment operations strongly preferred. Demonstrated readiness to lead a team, with experience mentoring junior staff, managing cross-functional workstreams, or standing in for a manager. Extensive experience in account reconciliation and using AI (e.g. Claude) and data tools (e.g., Looker) to identify financial patterns and drive business decisions. A proven track record of "creating order from chaos" by building sophisticated financial processes in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments. Strong technical aptitude and experience partnering with Product/Engineering to resolve bugs and build automated financial fail-safes. Proficiency in Asana, Jira, SQL, and Looker to manage financial workflows, track technical tasks, and report on program health. The base salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset. Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. This role is open to candidates in remote locations with a strong preference for San Francisco, CA; secondary locations include Seattle, WA and New York, NY. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction. At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams. Benefits That Work For You Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits: Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics. Whole-self care through wellness partnerships Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+) Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-manager-payments-reconciliation

As a Senior Data Analyst for Lab Production Support in our DSPE Extended-Hours Support (ExHS) team, you will work in the Weekend Shift team (following the above two rotation schedules). You will have the opportunity to apply innovative data analytics solutions, directly support the most cutting-edge medical diagnostics and genomics applications, and make real & immediate impact to patients and healthcare providers, by providing timely & accurate data analysis support to Natera's production laboratories, as well as for other key business needs. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Technical Execution and Infrastructure Deliver timely data support to Lab Operations teams, unblock production issues, and improve patient results turnaround times. Apply statistical techniques to analyze complex datasets, diagnose operational issues, and support data-driven decision-making. Perform exploratory data analysis, identify trends, and work with stakeholders to interpret findings and drive continuous improvement. Design and implement automated solutions for recurring data analysis and production support workflows, improving operational efficiency and scalability. Extract, transform, and analyze data to generate actionable insights that support lab production operations and business decisions. Document analytical processes, best practices, and insights to ensure consistency and knowledge transfer across teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Lab Operations and Product teams to identify process issues, assist with root cause analysis, and provide product support. Represent the Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) team in stakeholder meetings. Effectively and correctly escalate encountered issues to other DSPE teams. QUALIFICATIONS: Masters degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Operational Research, or other related fields. Minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience. Minimum 3 years of experience working in a highly regulated environment (e.g., CLIA and/or FDA compliant settings). Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, extraction, querying in production support roles. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Working knowledge of the business processes and requirements of diagnostic laboratories. Knowledge of molecular biology, genetics, genomics, and/or bioinformatics is a plus. Proficient in data analysis and statistical techniques. Proficient in Python and SQL development. Working knowledge of Snowflake platform and cloud technologies. Strong understanding of statistical concepts such as hypothesis testing, central limit theorem, time series analysis, anomaly detection, and regression modeling. Good documentation practices and coding style. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience using version control systems such as GitHub or GitLab for managing code and collaboration. Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment. Strong interpersonal skills. Strong integrity. items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #stack Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Germany (Remote) Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity Grafana Labs is looking for a Commercial Account Executive, Growth based in Germany who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across DACH. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before. What You’ll Be Doing Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals Outbound prospecting into net-new customers Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations) Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests What Makes You a Great Fit: 2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer) Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually Fluent in English & German Bonus Points For: Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage Experience using Salesforce Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal Compensation & Rewards In Germany, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 175,000 - EUR 185,000 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. items.description: Why Socure? Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Automation team. You will play a critical role in designing and building scalable data platforms and pipelines that power Socure’s identity verification products and analytics. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong passion for solving real business problems with data, and combines deep hands-on data engineering expertise with strong ownership. What You'll Do • Design and build batch and streaming data pipelines to support automated data ingestion, ML feature engineering and analytics across multiple product domains. • Own end-to-end delivery of complex, ambiguous data initiatives, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and documentation. • Develop and evolve the data platform to support large-scale data processing using modern cloud-native technologies. • Automate data operations (validation, quality checks, alerting, backfills, and recovery workflows) to reduce manual effort and improve consistency. • Optimize cost, performance, and reliability of data workloads. • Partner closely with cross-functional teams (Data Science, Product, Engineering) to understand requirements, translate them into technical solutions. • Evaluate and adopt new technologies (new processing engines, storage formats, orchestration tools, GenAI-assisted ingestion) to keep the platform modern and efficient. What You Bring • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, building and maintaining production-grade data platforms and pipelines. • Strong programming skills in general-purpose language (such as Python or Scala) for data processing, and SQL for data analytics. • Deep experience with distributed data processing frameworks, such as Apache Spark, including performance tuning and optimization. • Proven experience building data solutions using services on AWS (EMR, Lambda, s3, etc). • Strong understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts, including partitioning, schema design for large-scale datasets. • Experience operating and supporting production pipelines, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and improving reliability over time. • Solid foundation in software engineering practices, including version control, CI/CD, testing strategies, and code review. • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with streaming or near-real-time data processing (Kafka, Kinesis, etc). • Hands-on experience with data orchestration tools (Airflow, Step Functions, etc). • Familiarity with modern data platform patterns such as Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh, and large-scale data sharing across teams. • Experience with prompt engineering using modern GenAI, Large Language Models (LLM). • Experience mentoring other engineers and contributing to engineering-wide standards, best practices. As a note; Socure cannot provide sponsorship now or in the future for this role. Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly. Follow Us! By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future. The Senior Data Engineer will lead technical workstreams, contribute to defining data engineering best practices, and mentor other engineers while collaborating closely with Machine Learning Engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex data challenges. Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field. Apply now!

items.description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: We are seeking a dynamic Data Reports & Insights Analyst to join our Customer Success team. This role bridges the gap between data services and business intelligence. As a Reports & Insights Analyst, you'll help Cloudbeds customers turn raw operational and financial data into decisions they can act on. You'll build, analyze, and optimize reports across our PMS reporting suite, troubleshoot discrepancies before they become customer frustrations, and coach hoteliers on how to read metrics like ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, and channel performance with confidence. Every report you refine and every question you answer on calls or emails, directly shapes how hospitality businesses understand their own performance and grow their revenue. Our Team: Data Services sits at the intersection of hospitality expertise and reporting technology, working to make sure Cloudbeds customers never have to guess what their numbers mean. Reporting to your lead, you'll join a team that partners closely with Product, Onboarding, Support, and Customer Success to keep improving how customers access and interpret their data. It's a hands-on, collaborative group that treats every reporting question as a chance to make the platform and the customer's business a little smarter. What You Bring to the Team: You've spent time inside hotels and property management systems; you understand hospitality data isn't just numbers on a screen; it's occupancy, revenue, and guest behaviour telling a story. You're comfortable with advanced Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas) and have worked with BI or reporting tools involving dashboards, filters, and custom reports. You communicate clearly in written and verbal English, translating technical reporting concepts into plain language for customers who may not be data experts. You're detail-oriented, adaptable to shifting priorities, and genuinely enjoy solving the puzzle when a report doesn't add up. What Sets You Up for Success: Hospitality Tech Background: Direct experience working with Hotel Property Management Systems, channel managers and similar systems Client-Facing Expertise: A proven track record in onboarding, implementation, or Tier 2/3 technical support with a natural ability to teach and guide users. Advanced Spreadsheet Proficiency: Power-user skills in Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, and data cleaning). Analytical Mindset: Strong understanding of basic data management principles, data mapping, parsing, and root-cause error analysis. Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision when handling sensitive historical, financial, and guest records. Remote-First Readiness: Highly tech-savvy with cloud-based workflows and equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection for video coaching sessions. Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional): Multilingual Capabilities: Professional proficiency (verbal and written) in Spanish or Portuguese. BI & Analytics Familiarity: Prior experience working with business intelligence dashboards or advanced financial reporting structures. What to Expect - Your Journey with Us Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary. items.title: 🌍 Finance Research Expert, Remote- Contract
items.summary: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: • Equity Research • FP&A • Corporate Finance • Accounting or Audit • Investor Relations • Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: • Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours • Location: Remote, worldwide • You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP • Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: • You will work on questions about real US public companies.
items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

About the role At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human. We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working. This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates. You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes. Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations. What you'll do Own and improve our IT operations Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution. Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems. Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management. Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience. Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects. Build smarter systems through AI and automation Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT. Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency. Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes. Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work. Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance. Think like a product owner Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements. Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact. Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs. Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience. Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning. Collaborate across Typeform Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues. Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members. Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation. What you'll bring Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company. ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management. Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations. Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian. Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools. Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity. Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management. Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution. A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. Nice to have Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations. Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems. Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms. Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting. Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance. Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects. *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more. items.description: KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense. Position open to candidates located in Brazil . Please submit your resume in English. To learn more about our team and office culture in São Paulo, Brazil, visit the following links. Careers Page: https://www.knowbe4.com/careers/locations/sao-paulo Glassdoor : https://www.glassdoor.com/Location/KnowBe4-S%C3%A3o-Paulo-Location-EI_IE969384.0,7_IL[…]M_-C1lsxoZq7Cx8IriVE8MkrzuTmnJzqego77RAWZz9sqGt_55BflwYKpQeg LinkedIn : https://www.linkedin.com/company/knowbe4/life/brazil/ This is a Data Platform Engineering seat. Your mission is to build the tooling, infrastructure, and pipelines that allow engineering and product teams to self-serve while reliably delivering high-integrity data to customer-facing applications, internal reporting, ML models, and autonomous AI agents. You will join the core team behind our data platform: an event-driven lakehouse on AWS handling tens of thousands of events per second. You will design, build, and operate the near-real-time pipelines that model product and service events through medallion layers using open table formats and analytical engines, delivered as strictly tested, peer-reviewed, and version-controlled software. We build with agents, for agents: Our platform is itself agentic. We actively develop and maintain skills and AI agents that scaffold new pipelines, monitor upstream repositories and tickets for data-contract changes before they break downstream systems, autonomously triage alerts, and assist with cross-repo code reviews. Key Responsibilities Architect, deploy, and operate production near real-time streaming workloads on AWS from ingestion to analytical serving layers. Model complex event streams through bronze/silver/gold medallion architectures using modern open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg). Implement robust checkpointing, state recovery, schema evolution, and deduplication to safeguard against silent data corruption and ordering anomalies. Develop internal developer agents and automation loops (scaffolding, change detection, quality circuit breakers, and alert triage). Spot platform bottlenecks, architectural debt, or emerging technologies before anyone files a ticket—scope the solution and champion it to production. Requirements & Qualifications Experience owning production Spark streaming workloads, including orchestration, checkpointing, monitoring, alerting and failure recovery. Python you’d put your name on: tested, typed, reviewed and shipped through CI. AWS fluency and comfort reading and changing infrastructure as code. Hands-on experience with modern table formats, including upserts, schema evolution and the maintenance they need. Strong data modelling judgement, including knowing the tradeoffs and limits of a design. Experience with event-stream or CDC ingestion, and the de-duplication and ordering problems that come with it. The ability to take a vague stakeholder request, work out the real question, come back with a design, and explain the result and its caveats to people who don’t read code. The judgement to spot what the platform needs before anyone files a ticket, scope it and make the case for it, including new technologies where they would serve us better. A track record of raising the bar around you: reviewing, mentoring and setting conventions a team actually follows. Interest in or experience building, agentic tooling for engineering work itself: scaffolding, change detection, triage and review loops. Clear verbal and written English communication skills to collaborate effectively across international teams. Our Fantastic Benefits We offer company-wide bonuses based on monthly sales targets, employee referral bonuses, adoption assistance, tuition reimbursement, certification reimbursement, and certification completion bonuses - all in a modern, high-tech, and fun work environment. For more details about our benefits in each office location, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/benefits . Note: An applicant assessment and background check may be part of your hiring procedure. Individuals seeking employment at KnowBe4 are considered without prejudice to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/request-accommodation. No recruitment agencies, please.

items.description: At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. There’s something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams . Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We’re energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we’re just getting started! About the role Constant Contact has helped millions of small businesses grow for over 30 years. Now we’re building the next chapter: an AI-native product that does more of the work for our customers across the channels they care about. Text messaging is one of the most direct of those channels, and one of the least forgiving. This role owns product for Messaging, our SMS and conversational messaging business. You’ll build an AI-first experience that helps small business owners reach and talk with their customers by text. It has to be compliant, cost-aware, and trustworthy enough that owners let it handle real conversations. Messaging also has to make the whole platform better. It should work hand in hand with email, events, and social, and with the customer data underneath them, so that the whole is worth more than its parts. You’ll lead a small, high-trust team. Executive sponsorship is real, and the ambition is high. The bar is higher still, because a bad text reaches a customer’s phone, not their promotions tab. What you’ll do Own Messaging end-to-end. This covers list growth and consent capture, campaigns, automations, two-way conversations, and reporting. You’ll define the core flows, ship them, instrument them and iterate. Make AI that’s safe to let text on your behalf. An AI agent replying to an SMB’s customers carries more risk than one drafting a newsletter. You’ll decide how the product shows intent, respects owner constraints and brand voice, and knows when to hand a conversation back to a human. You’ll also decide how owners graduate from approving every message to trusting autonomous replies. Treat compliance as a product feature. You’ll own consent and opt-in flows, opt-out handling, quiet hours, content rules, and 10DLC/A2P registration. Make the compliant path the easy path so owners stay out of trouble without needing to understand TCPA. Own deliverability and unit economics. Carrier filtering, throughput, sender reputation, and per-message cost directly affect margin. You’ll understand them well enough to make pricing, packaging and product tradeoffs with finance and engineering. Pick the right leading indicators. Examples include activation (first compliant send), time-to-value, list growth, opt-out and complaint rates, reply and conversation rates, owner intervention rate, and attributed revenue. Retention is the lagging story; these are the levers. You’ll commit to numbers and defend them. Build for the whole platform. Messaging sits on shared platform capabilities and works alongside email, events and social. You’ll partner with the PMs and engineers who own those surfaces to create cross-channel experiences, like an event reminder by text or a reply that routes into the contact’s history, without adding overhead for either side. Be opinionated about AI UX. You’ll decide where LLMs make messaging magical and where they make it brittle or risky. You’ll own the eval bar for agent behavior: accuracy, compliance, safety, brand tone, and appropriateness for a 160-character channel. Have a strong point of view on when not to use AI. Use AI to build, not just to ship. Make AI-assisted research, prototyping and iteration the team’s default. Get from idea to tested artifact in days, not sprints. Get out of the building. Talk to small business owners weekly. Sit in support tickets, including the angry ones about blocked messages. Bring their voice into every roadmap conversation, loudly. Communicate up and across. Pitch the roadmap to executives, work through architecture with engineering, defend tradeoffs to design and legal, and turn customer pain into requirements engineers can act on. Who you are 8+ years product management experience. SaaS experience required; SMB experience strongly preferred. You’re genuinely AI-fluent. You’ve shipped LLM-powered features in production and understand prompt engineering, RAG, evals and agent architectures well enough to argue tradeoffs with engineers rather than just hand them a PRD. You have strong opinions on AI UX: when AI should be visible or invisible, when it should ask permission or just act, and why the answer is different when the output lands on a customer’s phone. You’re metrics-driven without being metric-blind. You build clear input → output → outcome pyramids, understand per-message economics, and know which qualitative signals dashboards miss. You respect and care about small businesses. You deeply empathize with their natural inclination to be nervous about texting customers, and your goal is to help them message customers in the right way to meet their goals. You have a bias toward action. You’d rather ship a rough version this week and learn than ship a polished version next quarter and guess, and you know which compliance lines are never “rough version” territory. You communicate directly. You give feedback kindly and clearly, disagree in the room, commit once the call is made, and don’t relitigate. Nice to haves Direct experience building agentic or conversational systems, such as AI replies, chatbots, or two-way messaging automation. Experience with RCS, WhatsApp Business, or other emerging messaging channels. Background in SMB SaaS or marketing technology. Experience building cross-channel products (email, SMS, events, social) on shared customer data. Experience with PLG motions, self-serve onboarding, and usage-based pricing. You’ve shipped SMS or messaging products at real volume. You know how 10DLC, carrier filtering, consent and opt-out actually work, and you’ve lived through at least one deliverability or compliance fire. A point of view on how AI agents will change the way businesses and customers talk to each other. #LI-HK1 #LI-Remote The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including the candidate’s experience, their education and work location. In addition, some roles may be eligible for additional on target commission pay or bonus. The compensation package includes health and welfare benefits including paid leave. Pay Transparency - All Full Time Employees $148,720—$185,977 USD Why You’ll Love Us: We celebrate one another’s differences. We are proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion, and we’re always working hard to strengthen and improve this culture. We have programs in place that bring us together on important issues and provide educational opportunities for all employees. Join the experts. If you’re passionate about supporting businesses and organizations, you won’t find a better spot to share your talent. We’re dedicated to improving the quality of our product from a customer standpoint and have a true desire to enable the success of businesses, non-profit organizations, and community groups. You’ll have opportunities to grow your career. items.description: What is PerfectServe? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! About the role PerfectServe is investing in a unified data platform spanning our product portfolio — the data store, the shared taxonomy, and the pipelines that will let the business answer questions across the whole platform. Our architecture team has mapped the high-level direction and target state. The detailed design is deliberately still open. This is the senior engineering seat that takes it from direction to working platform. You will shape the detailed architecture alongside our architecture team, own the implementation and integration design, and set the engineering standards the team works to — building it with a dedicated team. Why this role, specifically We have done real thinking here — the high-level direction and target state are mapped, and the business case is made and funded. What is deliberately not settled is almost everything below that line. We would rather hire someone with strong opinions about it than fill it in ourselves before you arrive. That is where the consequential decisions live — how entities resolve consistently across a broad portfolio, how time is modeled so a question about last quarter resolves against last quarter's reality, how a metric gets defined once and trusted everywhere. Cheap to get right now, expensive to correct later. So you get a direction to work from and an architecture team to partner with, plus genuine influence over both. If you would rather bring your experience to bear on a platform while it is being built than inherit one that is already set, this is that role. What you will do Own the implementation design across the platform — ingestion, modeling, and the surfaces people consume Shape the detailed architecture from the high-level direction, working with our architecture team Own integration design across a varied set of production source systems Build ingestion pipelines from those systems Model raw data into business-ready datasets, with one agreed definition per metric Set the engineering standards the team works to, including data quality and testing Partner with our platform and operations teams on safe, low-impact extraction from production databases Work directly with the people who need the data, so what gets built answers real questions Mentor data engineers and help shape their work What you bring Substantial experience building and operating cloud data platforms, ideally including one you designed from scratch Comfort making decisions with incomplete information, and the judgement to know which ones are expensive to get wrong Deep SQL, and strong command of a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks or similar) A transformation framework such as dbt, with clear opinions on how to structure a project ELT and change-data-capture experience across relational sources AWS — read replicas, object storage, and moving data between regions without surprises Dimensional or medallion modeling, applied rather than theoretical Workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or similar) and data quality testing as a habit Nice to have Healthcare data, and experience handling protected health information Multi-tenant data isolation Semantic layer or metrics layer design Modern BI and self-serve reporting tooling Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission‑driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. We offer a salary range of $170,000–$200,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and growth potential. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. Compensation is determined by several factors, including experience, skills, and team impact. We regularly review compensation to ensure fairness and consistency. Current employees with questions are encouraged to connect with their manager or People Operations. Benefits: Remote first work environment Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one. 401K - with match and immediately vested. 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy Internal Advancement Opportunities PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

items.description: iFIT ’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey. We're hiring a Director, Digital Analytics & Experimentation to own the numbers behind our direct-to-consumer business on nordictrack.com. This is an AI-first, global role spanning analytics, reporting, forecasting and experimentation, with subscription growth and the customer journey at the center. Leaders across the company make spending, pricing and merchandising decisions on your numbers. Why join iFIT and NordicTrack Connected fitness is a growing category at the center of health and wellness, and iFIT and NordicTrack are right in it. We sell more than equipment: the iFIT membership keeps customers training, so every conversion, test and forecast is a lifetime-value decision, not a one-time sale. As our Director, you'll be the person leadership turns to for what's working, what's next and what it's worth, with a direct line to the executives making the calls. You'll shape the nordictrack.com experience, grow customer lifetime value, and help us move to a new AI-driven personalization platform. We expect AI in every part of the job, to move faster and surface opportunities manual analysis would miss. What you'll do The role splits roughly evenly across three areas, and you own the integrity of all three. Analytics and data Pull and validate data from web analytics, order, media and finance sources, and keep documented KPI definitions as one source of truth. Diagnose performance changes by traffic source, product and funnel step, and make recommendations supported by quantified evidence. Track, analyze and report on our subscription economics, including customer lifetime value (LTV) and the annual iFIT subscription attach rate, and show what moves them. Map the customer journey from first visit through purchase and subscription, find what drives conversion and what blocks it, and tell us where to optimize first. Reporting and forecasting Own the daily, weekly and monthly performance reporting and the dashboards behind it, including LTV and subscription attach. Prepare executive-ready summaries of results versus plan and prior year, with the drivers behind each variance. Build and maintain the full P&L forecast for the DTC business, from traffic, conversion and subscription attach through revenue, margin and marketing spend, including media mix. Reconcile forecasts to actuals and finance, explain every variance, refresh the outlook regularly, and model scenarios (promotions, media shifts, pricing) with the assumptions written down. Experimentation and CRO Run the testing program end to end, from hypothesis and design to QA, readout and decision, and prioritize tests by their potential to lift conversion. Report test results with the correct statistical method, and state clearly what a result can and cannot support. Track the cumulative revenue and conversion impact of shipped tests. Help improve our personalization program by measuring what works, where it falls short and where to expand it. You will partner closely with marketing, digital product, site merchandising and finance, and manage and develop one direct report. What you bring 8+ years in analytics, at least 5 in ecommerce, DTC or subscription businesses, with people management experience. Proficient in SQL and experienced using AI across daily analytics work to move faster and find new opportunities, with the judgment to validate what it produces. Proven experience running a statistically rigorous experimentation program, with strong CRO instincts for what drives conversion and what blocks it. Experience building P&L or revenue forecasts and reconciling them to finance or ERP actuals. A proven record of accurate, reconciled numbers, with QA habits you can describe, and the ability to explain a number, its source and its caveats to executives. Hands-on experience with session analytics and multi-touch attribution tools, such as FullStory and Rockerbox. What success looks like in year one Your work drives measurable top-line and bottom-line growth, through higher conversion, subscription attach and customer lifetime value. A prioritized roadmap of customer journey and CRO improvements is live, with measured conversion lift. Leadership trusts the numbers without double-checking them: core KPI definitions are documented, reported figures tie to finance, and forecasts land close to actuals. AI is embedded in how you analyze, forecast and report, freeing time for higher-value work and surfacing new opportunities. DISCLAIMER Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan, and exemption status. Although we currently may consider hiring in the states listed below, not all positions are available in all locations, and work in a particular state is not guaranteed. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

Core Responsibilities Nano & Micro-Influencer Acquisition: Identify, pitch, and onboard local SoCal nano/micro-influencers (foodies, lifestyle, family, culture, and local deals) with active, hyper-local followings to promote the Asian American Expo. Grassroots Community Marketing: Actively seat promotional messaging, ticket offers, and event announcements across regional SoCal Facebook groups, local community forums, Nextdoor, Reddit, and cultural community boards. Direct-Response Campaign Execution: Focus messaging around high-converting hooks, specifically highlighting the event scale, food night market, and the "Luckiest Weekend of the Year" Red Envelope cash/prize drops. Weekly Conversion Tracking: Monitor link clicks, promo code redemptions, and ticket conversion rates, optimizing or sunsetting non-performing partnerships weekly. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Primary Metric: Total Event Ticket Sales & Revenue Generated (analyzed on a day by day snapshot compared to last year). Secondary Metric: Number of activated, high-converting local SoCal creators actively posting and driving trackable sales. Qualifications & Requirements Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience in direct-response marketing, affiliate management, event ticketing, or conversion-focused influencer outreach. SoCal Market Familiarity: Deep understanding of Southern California sub-markets, local food culture, Asian community networks, and regional interest groups (LA, SGV, Orange County, IE). Outreach Hustle: Strong negotiation and persuasion skills to quickly secure high-converting partnerships on lean timelines. Tools: Proficiency with Google Workspace, affiliate/promo tracking tools, Meta/Facebook group networking, and social outreach management. How to Apply Submit your resume along with 1–2 examples of previous campaigns where you directly drove sales or ticket conversions through grassroots outreach or creator partnerships. This is a remote position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/impulse-universe-inc-asian-american-expo-marketing-local-community-influencer-outreach
