items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: CA - San Francisco HQ; CA-Remote Employee Applicant Privacy Notice Who we are: Shape a brighter financial future with us. Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance. We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world. The role: SoFi is seeking an energetic, organized, and resourceful Direct Mail Marketing Manager for a one-year contract to manage the end-to-end direct mail creative process for the SoFi Credit Card product, from strategy and planning through creative development, stakeholder review, approval, production, and tracking. This role will also analyze campaign performance and provide recommendations to optimize future direct mail strategies and creative. At SoFi, you’ll become part of a new kind of finance company whose ambition is to help our members achieve financial independence and reach their goals. We aim to be at the center of our members’ financial lives and help every member get their money right. We created student loan refinancing, addressing the biggest financial challenge of a new generation through a modern approach to lending and personal finance. Next, we expanded our products and services across loans, investing, and cash management. SoFi has achieved significant growth, with ambitious plans ahead, but to continue this growth, we need great talent. And that starts with you. What you’ll do: This role owns four core areas of responsibility: 1. Creative Strategy & Planning Lead end-to-end creative strategy and execution for Credit Card direct mail campaigns, partnering with Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to align initiatives with business goals, priorities, and growth objectives. Lead quarterly creative planning with the creative agency, using audience insights, customer behavior, performance data, and test-and-learn principles to develop strategic recommendations for the Product Marketing Manager. Lead upfront data and audience planning with DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science and agency team defining targeting, segmentation, personalization, measurement requirements, and data inputs that inform the creative strategy, testing plan, and campaign brief. Own the creative roadmap and partner with the creative agency to develop compelling messaging, visual storytelling, offers, personalization, branding, and calls to action. 2. Campaign & Production Management Serve as the day-to-day campaign lead and primary liaison among Product Marketing Manager, the creative and data strategy agency, DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science, other internal stakeholders, and print vendors. Serve as the lead DM representative in Credit Card business unit meetings, Marketing Data Science handoff meetings, and other recurring meetings. Prepare slides as needed, capture key decisions and action items, and distribute notes to appropriate stakeholders. Translate approved strategies into actionable campaign plans, creative briefs, testing plans, and production requirements. Manage monthly direct mail tests and creative variations, ensuring audience definitions, segmentation, data requirements, personalization, and creative variants are aligned and executable. Own campaign timelines and the shared production calendar, including data due dates, creative milestones, review rounds, release dates, print dates, and drop dates. Manage assets, versioning, production samples, dependencies, risks, and bottlenecks to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time. Maintain the monthly campaign matrix, including audience targeting, creative variations, testing plans, data requirements, and other campaign details. Partner with Marketing Data Science to update campaign matrices and verify that targeting and personalization information is accurate before each drop. Lead weekly status meetings with Product Marketing Managers, including agenda development, stakeholder alignment, and action-item follow-up. 3. Compliance, Quality & Operations Lead the Compliance and Legal review process for direct mail materials, partnering with Product Marketing and the creative agency to ensure executions meet regulatory, disclosure, brand, and business requirements. Manage creative review and quality control across messaging, data, personalization, offers, URLs, disclosures, and final production files. Serve as the central point of accountability for ensuring every campaign is accurate, compliant, data-aligned, approved, and production-ready. Manage campaign production and postage costs, partnering with the DM billing team to keep campaigns within budget. 4. Performance, Insights & Competitive Intelligence Partner with Marketing Data Science, analytics, and the creative agency to evaluate campaign and creative test results against product and business goals. Translate audience, performance, and campaign data into actionable insights that inform creative recommendations, messaging, offers, personalization, segmentation, and future test strategies. Lead weekly Product Marketing Manager performance updates and monthly reporting, presenting results and optimization recommendations to Product Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders. Apply campaign learnings to improve future direct mail initiatives and inform the creative roadmap. Build and maintain a competitive direct mail library, monitoring competitor activity, creative trends, offers, formats, personalization, and audience strategies. Share monthly competitive and performance insights with the broader Marketing organization to inform future campaign and product marketing strategy. What you’ll need: Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of project management experience, preferably supporting direct mail or other marketing campaigns within financial services or another highly regulated industry. Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute complex, multi-channel campaigns and operational initiatives. Experience managing high-volume direct mail, CRM, lifecycle, or integrated marketing creative execution, ideally within financial services, credit cards, banking, or another highly regulated industry. Strong project and production management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, creative versions, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously. Highly proficient in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Gmail, and Calendar, Tableau, Snowflake; comfortable building and maintaining detailed trackers and production workflows. Strong understanding of creative development, production, version control, review/approval processes, and vendor management. Experience working directly with Legal, Compliance, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Data, and external production vendors. Strong attention to detail and a high level of ownership, particularly when managing personalized credit card communications where small errors can have significant downstream impact. Comfortable working in a test-and-learn environment, using campaign performance data to inform future creative decisions. Excellent communication and organizational skills with the ability to keep senior stakeholders informed while driving day-to-day execution. Financial services or credit card marketing experience strongly preferred, particularly familiarity with regulated marketing, compliance reviews, disclosures, and credit-related communications. Compensation and Benefits The base pay range for this role is listed below. Final base pay offer will be determined based on individual factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, and location. To view all of our comprehensive and competitive benefits, visit our Benefits at SoFi page! SoFi provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, breastfeeding, and conditions related to breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 or over), physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable state or federal law. The Company hires the best qualified candidate for the job, without regard to protected characteristics. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. New York applicants: Notice of Employee Rights SoFi is committed to an inclusive culture. As part of this commitment, SoFi offers reasonable accommodations to candidates with physical or mental disabilities. If you need accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, please let your recruiter know or email accommodations@sofi.com. We are unable to accommodate remote work from Hawaii, Alaska or Puerto Rico at this time. Internal Employees If you are a current employee, do not apply here - please navigate to our Internal Job Board in Greenhouse to apply to our open roles. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sofi-direct-mail-marketing-manager-credit-card-contract

items.title: E-commerce Data & Catalog Specialist
items.summary: Job Title: E-commerce Data & Catalog Specialist Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems.
items.description: Job Title: E-commerce Data & Catalog Specialist Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Key Responsibilities: Manage, structure, and curate large-scale e-commerce product catalogs, ensuring data accuracy and consistency across platforms. Develop, implement, and refine product taxonomy frameworks to simulate real-world e-commerce classifications and browsing experiences. Normalize and map product data sourced from diverse databases, applying best practices in structured dataset management. Create and model realistic shopping scenarios that reflect authentic consumer behavior and decision-making processes. Collaborate with AI development teams to define data needs and optimize catalog structures for scalable AI training. Ensure strict adherence to data quality, integrity, and normalization standards within SQL and NoSQL environments. Document workflows, taxonomies, and metadata structures with clear, concise written communication. Required Skills and Qualifications: Demonstrated experience in product catalog management and e-commerce merchandising operations. Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL database concepts, schema design, and product data modeling. Strong command of product taxonomy development, categorization, and data normalization methods. Deep understanding of structured dataset management, including large and complex e-commerce catalogs. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and communicate technical concepts clearly. Experience building data-driven shopping experiences and simulating consumer journeys. High attention to detail and a collaborative mindset for working with cross-functional teams. Preferred Qualifications: Previous involvement with AI, machine learning, or data annotation projects. Experience with scalable catalog schema design for diverse online marketplaces. Background in creating advanced metadata structures or contributing to AI training initiatives. Additional Info: This is an AI training-focused role. You'll play a key part in constructing realistic, data-rich e-commerce environments to improve AI model understanding and performance. Join our customer's team to help shape the future of intelligent shopping experiences. Originally posted on Himalayas

Track record of delivering accurate, audit-ready analysis under deadline pressure â the kind of work that goes to the CRO without a second pass. Highly organized self-starter with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive work forward without waiting to be asked. Familiarity with revenue intelligence platforms (Clari, Gong, or similar) and how they integrate into a Salesforce-based GTM data model. Comfort working with large datasets in Databricks, Snowflake, or similar platforms beyond basic Excel and BI tool work. Working knowledge of automation tools and AI/ML fundamentals â you donât need to build the models, but you understand how to leverage them in operational workflows. Background in cybersecurity or identity security markets. Better Together Diversity. Inclusion. Theyâre more than just words for us. items.summary: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch.
items.description: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled. What You'll Do Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates. Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date. Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays. Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections. Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call. Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin. Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event. Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation. Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture. Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators. What We're Looking For 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise. Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races. Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts). Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts. Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls. Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination. Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known. Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics. Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights. Nice to Have Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket. Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant. Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps. Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards. Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote URL: http://wevote.us Help Shape How Millions of Voters Engage with Reliable Civic Information WeVote is a nonpartisan civic technology nonprofit dedicated to increasing voter participation through innovative digital tools and trusted voter education resources. As a Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee, WeVote empowers voters with the information they need to make informed decisions and participate confidently in democracy. We are seeking a strategic and innovative Director of Content Strategy to lead the development and execution of WeVote's content vision across digital channels. This volunteer leadership role is ideal for an experienced content strategist, communications leader, digital marketer, or media professional who is passionate about civic engagement and audience growth. As Director of Content Strategy, you will define how WeVote communicates with voters, volunteers, supporters, and stakeholders through impactful content initiatives. You will oversee content planning, messaging strategy, editorial priorities, audience engagement efforts, and cross-functional collaboration to expand WeVote's reach and influence. What You'll Do Develop Content Strategy Create and lead a comprehensive content strategy that aligns with WeVote's mission, organizational goals, audience needs, and voter engagement objectives. Drive Audience Growth & Engagement Identify opportunities to expand audience reach, increase engagement, and strengthen relationships with voters, volunteers, donors, and supporters through strategic content initiatives. Lead Content Planning Oversee content roadmaps, editorial calendars, and campaign planning across blogs, newsletters, voter education resources, thought leadership content, and digital communications. Shape Organizational Messaging Develop messaging frameworks and content guidelines that ensure consistency across all channels while reinforcing WeVote's nonpartisan mission and brand voice. Collaborate Across Teams Partner with leaders across Product, Political Data, Communications, Marketing, Partnerships, and Volunteer Recruitment to identify content opportunities and align messaging efforts. Analyze Content Performance Monitor content effectiveness, audience behavior, engagement metrics, and communication trends to continuously improve content strategy and impact. Lead Content Contributors Provide strategic guidance and leadership to volunteer writers, editors, researchers, content creators, and communications team members. Support Thought Leadership Initiatives Help position WeVote as a trusted leader in civic technology, voter education, and democratic participation through compelling storytelling and content innovation. What We're Looking For Content Strategy Experience 3+ years of experience in content strategy, communications, digital marketing, content leadership, audience development, media, publishing, or related fields. Strategic Thinking Demonstrated ability to create and execute content strategies that drive awareness, engagement, audience growth, and organizational impact. Audience & Engagement Expertise Experience understanding audience needs, developing content journeys, and optimizing content performance across digital channels. Strong Communication Skills Exceptional writing, editing, messaging, and storytelling abilities with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, accessible content. Data-Informed Decision Making Comfortable using content analytics, engagement insights, and performance metrics to guide strategic decisions. Cross-Functional Leadership Experience collaborating with diverse stakeholders and managing projects across multiple teams and initiatives. Mission Alignment Passion for democracy, civic engagement, voter education, and leveraging content to create meaningful social impact. Self-Starter Mentality Ability to thrive in a remote, volunteer-driven environment while independently driving strategic initiatives forward. Why Join WeVote? Help shape how millions of voters access and engage with trusted civic information. Lead content strategy for a nationally recognized civic technology nonprofit. Build executive-level experience in digital strategy, communications, and audience development. Collaborate with mission-driven professionals in technology, media, civic engagement, and nonprofit leadership. Make a measurable impact on voter participation and democratic engagement. Position Details Location: Remote (U.S.-based volunteers preferred) Time Commitment: Approximately 5–10 hours per week Compensation: Volunteer Position * Fraud and phishing warning * Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Germany Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business. Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions. The police are one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. Police officers spend a large proportion of their time on data work and comparatively little on the actual investigation. We want to turn that around. With our new police solution, Metropolis, we help police authorities connect and make sense of their data, so that officers can focus on what matters most: solving cases and keeping people safe . To address this, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Police . The Role: This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows police work from the inside: how investigations really run, where time is lost in data work, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships with police authorities at federal and state level and position Celonis as a long-term partner for their digital transformation. Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of police work into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market. The Work you'll do: Build and own relationships with police authorities at federal and state level, e.g. Bundespolizei, Bundeskriminalamt (BKA), Landeskriminalämter (LKA), Landespolizeien and the responsible Interior Ministries . Engage with decision-makers from police leadership, investigation units, IT and digitalization departments, and procurement Translate investigators' daily challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases for Celonis and Metropolis, with measurable impact (e.g. time saved per case, faster case processing). Bring the voice of the police into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering. Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close. Navigate public procurement and tender processes (e.g. VgV, VSVgV, UVgO, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts. Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and public IT service providers. Represent Celonis at public sector events, conferences and police-specific forums. The qualifications you need: Several years of professional experience within the German police (federal or state level), ideally in a leadership role and/or in an area close to investigations, criminal analysis, IT, digitalization or organizational development. A solid network within the police landscape and a deep understanding of how police authorities and Interior Ministries are organized, how decisions are made and how budgets are planned. First-hand understanding of the data challenges in police work, e.g. case management, evidence and data analysis, and cross-agency information sharing. A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. Prior experience in sales, business development or consulting is a plus, but not a must. We will support your onboarding into the sales role. Strong affinity for technology, data and AI, and the ability to explain complex topics in a simple and convincing way. Degree in Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program Grit, a hands-on mindset, and the drive to build something new. Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and very good English. Familiarity with public procurement processes is a strong plus. Willingness and eligibility to undergo a security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) if required by our customers. Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset. Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins #LI-SS6 What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/celonis-account-executive-public-sector-germany-police-polizei

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Yerevan, Remote, Armenia URL: http://capslock.global CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions. At CapsLock , people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success. ﻿Role overview Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly. You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow. If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process. Responsibilities Task & Pipeline Management Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system). Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed Quality Control Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals Reporting & Documentation Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards Process Improvement & AI Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes Creative Collaboration Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time Must-Have Skills Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content Technical Skills 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher Soft Skills Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines Clear, professional communicator Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas What we offer Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact. Paid vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet. Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more. Home Office - We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience. Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program. Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/capslock-creative-marketing-project-coordinator-1

items.title: Enterprise Performance Lead
items.summary: Clover is reinventing health insurance by working to keep people healthier. The Actuarial Strategic Operations team serves as the operational and financial nerve center for Clover's Medicare Advantage business. Embedded within the Actuarial and Finance organization, the team combines deep business expertise with advanced analytics and AI to integrate financial, operational, and actuarial insights, monitor enterprise performance, evaluate strategic initiatives, and deliver timely recommendations that improve affordability, member outcomes, and financial performance. At Clover, AI is part of how we work. We expect leaders to thoughtfully incorporate tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and emerging enterprise AI technologies into their daily workflows to improve analytical quality, accelerate execution, and enable better decisions. The Enterprise Performance Lead serves as a strategic business partner within Clover's Actuarial Strategic Operations, owning financial and operational partnership for one or more areas across the Medicare Advantage business. This role partners across Finance, Actuarial, Clinical, Revenue, Pharmacy, and Operations to align operational execution with financial performance, ensuring enterprise initiatives deliver expected outcomes. As a member of the Actuarial Strategic Operations team, you will leverage automation and AI-enabled ways of working to enhance analytical workflows, improve reporting, accelerate insight generation, and strengthen executive decision support. The Enterprise Performance Lead reports to the Director of Actuarial Strategic Operations and serves as a strategic business partner within Clover's MA Plan Actuarial Strategic Operations team. Successful candidates are curious, analytical, and collaborative problem-solvers who enjoy working across multiple business functions to evaluate strategic initiatives, identify opportunities, As an Enterprise Performance Lead, you will: Develop and continuously evolve performance monitoring frameworks using leading and lagging indicators, dashboards, and KPIs to evaluate initiative performance, proactively identify execution risks, and recommend actions that enable faster, data-driven decision making. Translate operational performance into financial insights by leveraging AI alongside traditional financial analysis to evaluate initiative performance, identify variances, surface emerging risks and opportunities, and communicate actionable recommendations that inform business decisions and financial objectives.Â Â Lead financial and operational workstreams for priority initiatives from evaluation through implementation and outcome monitoring, partnering with business owners to identify risks, track performance against expectations, and recommend corrective actions when results deviate from plan. Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Actuarial, Medical Economics, Clinical Operations, Revenue, Pharmacy, Product, and Analytics to align operational execution with business and financial priorities, integrate cross-functional insights, and advise financial planning and strategic decision making. Lead executive reporting and business reviews with oversight from the Director by developing dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reporting that leverage automation and AI to improve analytical efficiency, reporting quality, and leadership visibility into performance.Â Drive operational excellence by standardizing reporting processes, improving data quality, identifying opportunities for automation, and adopting AI-enabled solutions that reduce manual effort, accelerate analysis, and improve scalability across assigned business areas. Success in this role looks like: In your first 90 days, you will:Â Build strong cross-functional partnerships with business leaders to understand operational priorities and establish yourself as a trusted business partner.Â Â Learn the financial drivers, operational workflows, and strategic initiatives within your assigned area(s) of responsibility. Develop effective dashboards, KPIs, and AI-enabled reporting that provide timely visibility into initiative performance, financial impact, and execution progress. After 6 months, you will:Â Deliver regular business reviews that communicate initiative performance, financial impact, emerging risks, and opportunities using clear, data-driven insights. Implement proactive performance monitoring that leverages leading indicators and AI-assisted analysis to identify execution gaps and recommend timely actions. Become a trusted business partner by providing actionable financial and operational insights that influence decision making across your assigned business areas. Future success in this role includes: Influence business decisions and priorities within assigned areas by delivering data-driven financial and operational insights that improve enterprise decision making. Drive reporting and analytical excellence by expanding automation, improving data quality, and increasing the efficiency and scalability of reporting processes. Help establish the Actuarial Strategic Operations as a trusted source of performance insights, execution monitoring, and financial intelligence. You will love this role if: You enjoy solving complex and ambiguous business challenges through data-driven analysis, AI-enabled exploration, and structured problem solving. You are energized by influencing business decisions through financial insights, rapid experimentation, and actionable recommendations powered by modern analytical and AI tools. You thrive in highly collaborative environments, partnering across cross-functional teams to solve complex cross functional challenges and adopt new ways of working.Â You enjoy building new capabilities, AI-enabled workflows, and scalable reporting processes that improve organizational performance and create lasting business value. You should get in touch if: You have experience: 4-6 years of experience in healthcare medical economics, population health, analytics, actuarial, consulting, strategy, or operations, with demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives and delivering data-driven business insights. Experience applying AI to improve analytical workflows, operational efficiency, or business decision-making is strongly preferred.Â You have industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of Medicare Advantage, managed care, payer economics or value-based healthcare preferred.Â You have technical Skills: Experience using Python or R, business intelligence platforms, and modern AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, improve reporting, and enhance decision support is strongly preferred.Â You have an AI Mindset: Demonstrates curiosity, sound judgment, and a continuous improvement mindset in applying AI to solve business problems, automate routine work, improve analytical quality, accelerate execution, and enhance decision-making while maintaining appropriate governance, data integrity, and analytical rigor. Â You have communication: Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into actionable business insights and recommendations for business leaders.Â You have a demonstrated ability to build trusted cross-functional partnerships, influence stakeholders and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.Â You have preferred Domain Experience: Experience supporting one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:Â â Clinical Care Delivery, Care Management, or Value-Based Care â Utilization Management, Payment Integrity, FWA Investigations, or Provider Operations â Risk Adjustment, Revenue Operations, Medicare Stars, Growth, or Member Experience â Pharmacy Operations, Medicare Part D Benefits Overview :Â Â Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.Â Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most. We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare. From Cloverâs inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of oneâs identity. All of our employeeâs points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicantâs education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $111,000 â $144,000 USD Please mention the word **ALTRUISTIC** and tag RMjAuMTY5LjEyNC42OQ== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuMTY5LjEyNC42OQ==). items.title: Technical Sales Engineer
items.summary: We are seeking a professional with technical knowledge and consultative sales skills to lead virtual dashboard demonstrations, understand prospect needs, and explain how relevant features support their priorities.
items.description: We are seeking a professional with technical knowledge and consultative sales skills to lead virtual dashboard demonstrations, understand prospect needs, and explain how relevant features support their priorities. Key Responsibilities: - Lead engaging live demonstrations of the Ai-RGUS dashboard for technical and nontechnical prospects, following the company-provided script and demonstration structure. - Deliver designated sections verbatim and ensure all required points are covered. - Ask discovery questions about prospects' security environments, reporting needs, and operational challenges to tailor product demonstrations. - Demonstrate dashboard navigation, device information, alerts, report configuration, and integrations within Ai-RGUS, highlighting relevant features and their practical value to support the sales process. - Manage questions and objections, maintain the presentation flow, and coordinate with the technical team to provide accurate answers when needed. - Respond to Tier 1 technical questions about the product via email. Required Qualifications: - At least 3 years of experience in technical sales, presales, sales engineering, solutions consulting, or a similar role involving live software demonstrations to prospects. - Bachelor's degree in Science or an equivalent technical degree. - Strong technical aptitude and the ability to learn software configurations and explain them in clear, practical terms. - Demonstrated consultative sales skills, including active listening, needs assessment, and connecting product features to business value. - Excellent spoken and written English, with clear and articulate communication skills readily understood by U.S. business audiences during virtual presentations. - Ability and willingness to adhere to an approved script, retain required wording, accept coaching, and incorporate feedback. - Confidence in screen sharing and virtual meeting management, along with a reliable internet connection, a professional meeting environment, and strong preparation and follow-through. Please send your updated resume to Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Customer Support - Resolution & Outbound Retention Specialist (Voice)
items.summary: Headquarters: Indonesia URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/hS1Fg6yA2YGb3vBeEZy9fP/jobs-at-umaez-llc About US We are a 7-8 figure direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand portfolio operating across the US and international markets, led by our flagship brand GODA. We build and scale high-demand beauty, fragrance, and personal care products shipped directly
items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Indonesia URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/hS1Fg6yA2YGb3vBeEZy9fP/jobs-at-umaez-llc About US We are a 7-8 figure direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand portfolio operating across the US and international markets, led by our flagship brand GODA. We build and scale high-demand beauty, fragrance, and personal care products shipped directly to hundreds of thousands of customers. At our scale, customer trust, fast problem resolution, and post-purchase loyalty are everything. When a customer experiences friction, whether a delayed delivery, a subscription billing question, or a public escalation, this role turns a frustrated buyer back into a loyal brand advocate. The Role Standard customer support reacts to incoming tickets. As Executive Resolution & Outbound Retention Specialist, you prevent churn and protect brand reputation. Sitting inside our Outbound, Retention & Reputation team, you are the senior voice customers speak with when high-priority issues arise, and the proactive specialist who reaches out by phone and email to recover failed payments, retain subscribers, and grow verified 5-star reviews. What You'll Be Doing BBB & High-Priority Escalation Ownership 24-Hour SLA Resolution: Monitor, respond to, and resolve incoming BBB complaints and public review escalations within a strict under-24-hour response window. Phone-First De-Escalation: Conduct calm, empathetic outbound calls to frustrated US customers, diagnose what went wrong in Shopify/Commslayer, and deliver fair, tailored solutions (express reshipments, Loop exchanges, store credit, or approved refunds). Official Portal Closure: Draft clear, non-defensive written responses inside the BBB Business Portal and follow up directly with customers until they confirm satisfaction and close the case. Cross-Functional Fulfillment Coordination: Partner directly with our Order Fulfillment team to expedite stuck, delayed, or partially fulfilled orders tied to escalated cases. Outbound Retention, Payment Recovery & Reputation Growth Failed Payment & Win-Back Calls: Execute daily outbound phone calls and tailored email follow-ups to help subscribers update failed payment methods and keep active deliveries running smoothly. Subscription Save Outreach: Connect with at-risk or canceling subscribers to understand friction points and offer flexible alternatives (skips, cadence adjustments, or product swaps). Trustpilot Review Generation: Reach out to verified happy GODA customers via phone and email to encourage authentic 5-star reviews on Trustpilot and public storefronts. Escalated Email Queue: Handle sensitive email threads escalated from Inbound Customer Care involving dispute/chargeback threats, billing misunderstandings, or repeat delivery issues. Tracking, Compliance & Root-Cause Feedback 100% Case Hygiene: Maintain accurate, real-time logs across Commslayer, Shopify, and the BBB resolution tracker so zero open cases fall through the cracks. Upstream Prevention: Tag recurring escalation drivers (carrier delays, renewal confusion, SKU defects) and share weekly insights with the CS Manager and Process Experts to fix root causes. Must-Haves Proven Voice + Email Experience: 2+ years in DTC e-commerce customer support, escalations, retention, or account resolution, with strong comfort making daily outbound phone calls and writing tailored escalation emails. US-Overlap Availability: Able to work a full-time shift overlapping with US daytime/afternoon hours to reach US customers live by phone. Composed, Persuasive Communication: Clear, warm, natural English (spoken and written) with the emotional intelligence to de-escalate upset buyers without sounding scripted or defensive. High Follow-Through Discipline: You never mark a case finished until the resolution is confirmed by the customer and properly logged in external portals. Tech-Stack Fluency: Hands-on comfort working daily in e-commerce order dashboards, helpdesks, cloud VoIP dialers, and Google Sheets trackers. Strong Advantages Reputation & Dispute Experience: Prior hands-on management of Better Business Bureau (BBB) complaints, Trustpilot outreach, or chargeback/dispute prevention. DTC Core Tools: Direct experience with Shopify, Commslayer (or Zendesk/Gorgias), Loop Returns, Aircall/RingCentral, and subscription platforms (Recharge, Skio, or Stay AI). Subscription Brand Background: Previous experience supporting a high-volume DTC beauty, fragrance, wellness, or personal care subscription brand. Instant No's Phone Hesitation: You prefer hiding behind email macros rather than picking up the phone to speak directly with an upset customer. Copy-Paste Mindset: You rely on rigid policy scripts instead of listening to the customer's actual issue and tailoring the fix. Loose Documentation: Forgetting to update trackers or close portal responses. Accurate records protect both the customer and our brand rating. How We Measure Your Performance BBB SLA & Closure Rate: 100% first outreach within 24 hours and measurable month-over-month improvement in GODA's BBB resolution rate and profile rating. De-Escalation & Retention Save Rate: Percentage of escalations, failed payments, and at-risk subscriptions resolved without chargebacks or churn. Outbound Activity Consistency: Daily completion of outbound call and email targets across BBB, payment recovery, and review queues. QA & Compliance Score: Consistent adherence to brand voice, pre-approved resolution authority limits, and zero billing/compliance errors. Hiring Process & Compensation Competitive base salary based on experience + QA-gated monthly performance bonus tied to retention saves, payment recovery, and escalation resolution. 100% remote role inside a structured 7-8 figure DTC Customer Experience organization with clear growth into Senior Anchor, QA, or Team Lead roles. Selection Gate: Shortlisted candidates complete a brief 5-minute live phone de-escalation roleplay and a short written BBB response test. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/umaez-llc-customer-support-resolution-outbound-retention-specialist-voice

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://www.catonetworks.com Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. Cato Networks is seeking a NOC Engineer to join the team. In this critical role, you will be monitoring, supporting, and providing advanced troubleshooting of a large complex data network infrastructure by using network monitoring and management tools. You will work closely with teams from our business areas, network engineering, and management as a team representative on major incident bridges. This is a remote position based in the Philippines. Key Responsibilities Own and manage the uptime, stability, and overall functionality of the company’s production systems. This includes troubleshooting and resolving system and network issues end-to-end. Monitor and respond to NetOps alerts during working hours, and review/follow up on alerts triggered outside business hours as required. Continuously track and analyze system performance to identify risks, bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and opportunities for optimization. Proactively mitigate outages and system malfunctions to prevent customer impact. When necessary, prepare clear and prioritized escalations to the relevant Development teams. Coordinate with third-party service providers (e.g., carriers, SMS providers, IX providers, and other vendors) to resolve network and system-related issues. Provide advanced (higher-tier) technical support to internal Customer Support teams (T1–T3). Design, implement, and maintain dashboards and alerting mechanisms to ensure system visibility and operational awareness. Serve as a technical focal point for Customer Support and Field Engineering teams by understanding business use cases and translating them into operational requirements. Contribute to building, improving, and expanding NetOps ownership, processes, documentation, and operational best practices. Role Scope The role is primarily driven by automated system alerts requiring investigation, troubleshooting, and escalation when necessary. The role also involves handling customer-impacting issues escalated by the Customer Support organization. In addition to reactive tasks, the position includes ongoing projects and operational initiatives to be managed during working hours. Required Skills & Experience Strong experience in network architecture, cloud architecture, and security architecture. Deep knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, firewalls, proxy servers, and related technologies. Strong ability to analyze system and application logs to identify root causes of issues. Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex network and system incidents. Experience working in a Cloud or SaaS technology environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document findings and communicate with cross-functional teams. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple concurrent projects and incidents simultaneously. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cato-networks-noc-engineer

Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets manageme
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, U.S. Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com . The Role This role leads the North America MidMarket team and is accountable for new logo acquisition and expansion revenue across the segment. The expectations are high: a team that generates its own pipeline, deals that are qualified with discipline, forecasts that hold, and Account Executives who improve every quarter. This is not an oversight role. The leader in this seat works alongside their team, sets the standard for outbound execution, and uses data to drive performance. It is built for a first-line leader who has already delivered results and wants to operate at the pace and scale of a fast-growing company. Responsibilities Deal leadership Engage directly in the team's most important opportunities: discovery, executive alignment, mutual close plans, pricing and commercial structure, procurement, and security review. Set the standard for value-based selling: quantifying the customer's business pain, building the business case, and tying Bitwarden to measurable risk reduction and operational outcomes. Diagnose and unblock stalled deals, and use them to raise the skill level of the entire team. Outbound pipeline generation Build and mature a repeatable cold outbound motion with AEs and partnered SDRs: territory and account prioritization, ICP and persona targeting, multi-threaded sequencing, and messaging that resonates with IT, security, and finance buyers. Set activity and pipeline-generation standards, inspect them weekly, and hold every AE accountable for self-sourced pipeline. Align with Marketing and Sales Development on programs that produce qualified pipeline at a predictable rate. MEDDPICC and value-based execution Run MEDDPICC as the team's operating system across qualification, deal reviews, forecast calls, and win/loss analysis, with value-based selling defining how the team earns and proves each element. Inspect every material opportunity for quantified Metrics, a validated Economic Buyer, a tested Champion, clear Decision Criteria and Process, a mapped Paper Process, and an honest read on Competition. Deliver an accurate weekly forecast built on deal evidence and maintain CRM data the business can rely on. Data-driven coaching Own the team's KPIs (pipeline generation, coverage, stage conversion, win rate, cycle length, average deal size, and activity-to-outcome ratios) and act on what they show. Identify where each AE is losing ground (pipeline creation, qualification, progression, or close) and build targeted coaching plans to close the gap. Run a disciplined operating cadence: weekly 1:1s, pipeline and deal reviews, forecast calls, and call reviews. Team building Recruit, hire, onboard, and ramp high-caliber Account Executives, and develop them toward promotion. Build a culture of accountability, competitiveness, and continuous improvement. Work across Sales Operations, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Channel, and Marketing to deliver revenue as one team. Requirements 3–5 years of first-line sales leadership, ideally leading AEs selling security SaaS (identity, access, credential, endpoint, or adjacent categories). A proven, documented track record of quota attainment as a leader, and as an individual contributor before that. Deep working fluency in MEDDPICC and value-based selling, applied together to qualify, inspect, forecast, and coach. A track record of building and maturing a cold outbound pipeline, with the ability to explain exactly how it was done and what it produced. Strong analytical skills, including fluency with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and spreadsheets, and a record of using KPIs to direct coaching and improve AE performance. A hands-on approach to leadership, with direct, regular involvement in live deals. Strong intellect, a fast learning curve, and the drive to perform in a high-growth environment with demanding targets. Experience selling to IT, security, and executive buyers in organizations of roughly250–2,500 employees. A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations. Become an expert in a growing market. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup. We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $145,000- $160,000, plus uncapped variable compensation. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-mid-market-sales-leader

items.description: WilkinGuttenplan is seeking a talented Client Accounting & Advisory Services (CAS) Manager to join our growing team. This role is a great fit for an experienced supervisor ready to take the next step, a newly promoted manager looking to build on that experience, or someone ready to make a move for the promotion to manager. We offer flexible opportunities, including hybrid, fully remote, or in-office positions, with a preference for candidates near our New Jersey location! Responsibilities Coordinate service activities with clients, oversee staff accountants, and leverage AI agents to support service delivery. Oversee the day-to-day accounting services for clients. Direct oversight of the general ledger postings. Accounts payable oversight including cash management and bill payment. Employee expense reimbursement oversight. Payroll processing review and collaboration with clients. Oversight of client billing and revenue recognition. Review the month-end close process. Detail review of reconciliations for balance sheet accounts. Analyze the balance sheet, profit and loss, and cash flow statements. Ensure books are maintained in compliance with individual client expectations, GAAP, income tax cash basis, income tax accrual basis, or other comprehensive basis of accounting. Review consolidations and foreign currency translations. Oversee the monthly financial reporting package including dashboards, KPIs, and narratives. Oversee client onboarding. Support clean-up projects, software implementations, and accounting assessments. Support A&A and tax departments. Hand off historical reporting to the fractional CFO and collaborate with them as needed. Maintain ongoing relationships with clients. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance. CPA license required. 5+ years of recent work experience as an accountant in a Client Accounting Department (CAS), or experience working in an outsourced accounting or CFO firm. Experience supervising or leading a team of accountants. Experience with QuickBooks Online required. Experience with Sage, NetSuite, or Yardi preferred but not required. Experience with Ramp and Bill.com required. Experience in the following industries preferred but not required: Technology and SaaS, Professional Services, Real Estate, E-commerce, Financial Services. Proficient in Excel. Familiarity with AI tools and agents. Able to function in a team setting and collaborate with others. Strong organizational and communication skills. Why us? We offer a unique culture that emphasizes and values work/life balance including remote work flexibility! We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, including Unlimited Work Options, Unlimited PTO, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Summer Fridays, and much more! For more information on our offerings please visit our website. Our collaborative work environment is strongly committed to your professional growth and success. We have an extensive Coaching Program designed to prepare you for a life in a dynamic CPA firm. We have a track record of ranking in the Best Place to Work NJ for the past twenty-two years and have won several other awards including #1 in Vault’s Top 3 Internships, Best Firms for Young Accountants, Best Accounting Firms To Work For, and many more! The estimated salary range for this position is $103,000 to $135,000. Individual salaries are determined through multiple factors permitted by law including but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certification, knowledge, skills and qualifications. WG also offers a comprehensive benefits package and performance award (bonus) eligibility where you’ll be recognized and rewarded based on your performance. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. We believe in equal opportunity: Wilkin & Guttenplan P.C. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.
